node.to: 一份热气腾腾的米饭，上面切着大葱，给人一种新鲜的感觉

node.id: Cooked rice pressed into shape with a topping made of fish. Quick to eat but keeps you nourished for a long time.
node.to: 用米饭和鱼肉制做的美食

node.id: A bowl of steaming hot cooked rice with traditionally spiced meat on top with a flourish of carrots on the side.
node.to: 一碗热气腾腾的米饭，盖上五香牛肉和胡萝卜

node.id: A tomato soup spiked with hot spices for that pleasantly burning sensation.
node.to: 西红柿汤里面添加红辣椒，热辣鲜爽

node.id: A couple of hot dogs topped with a hot meat sauce. A prized food among hedgehogs for some reason.
node.to: 热狗上面浇着热乎乎的辣酱

node.id: A delicious and spicy dish that will leave one warm and fulfilled.
node.to: 美味而辛辣的菜，让人感到温暖和满足

node.id: A perfectly ordinary bread with a crunchy, flavourful crust made of cornmeal.
node.to: 一种玉米粉制成的普通面包，面包皮松脆可口

node.id: A pasta dish with a rich meaty sauce with added tomato.
node.to: 搭配了浓郁的肉酱和西红柿的意大利面

node.id: Spiced meat and lettuce wrapped into a tight package with flatbread.
node.to: 包裹着肉丝和生菜玉米卷饼

node.id: Know your enemy. Feast on your enemy.

node.to: 可以在营地 [GREEN]发明[WHITE]和[GREEN]制作[WHITE] 新的物品

node.id: Start [GREEN]gathering[WHITE] mushrooms, bird eggs, and other useful resources that can be found in the wilderness.
node.to: 允许在野外[GREEN]收集[WHITE] 蘑菇、鸟蛋和其它有用资源

node.id: Choose between [GREEN]4[WHITE] skills instead of 3 when leveling up.
node.to: 升级的时候可选技能从3个变为[GREEN]4[WHITE]个

node.id: Choose between [GREEN]5[WHITE] skills instead of 4 when leveling up.
node.to: 升级的时候可选技能从4个变为[GREEN]5[WHITE]个

node.id: [GREEN]Eat[WHITE] edible materials you are carrying to regain [GREEN]Hit Points[WHITE]. Press [BUTTON=DROP] to open the menu during the game.
node.to: [GREEN]进食[WHITE] 可食用物品可以获得 [GREEN]生命值[WHITE]。按[BUTTON=DROP] 打开菜单
可以利用[GREEN]治疗物品[WHITE]治愈自己

node.id: Increases chance of finding extra materials when searching.
node.to: 提高搜索速度，增加找到更多数量材料的机会，对稀有材料影响较低

node.id: Kill monsters. Any kind will do.
Hunt animals by any means imaginable.

node.to: 打开 [GOAL] 个计时补给箱
提升 [GOAL] 座链塔的等级

node.id: The bridge leading over the icy crevasse seems to be broken. Perhaps it could be fixed with some high quality [GREEN]Lumber[WHITE]?
node.to: 通过悬崖裂谷的桥好像断了，需要找到相应数量的[GREEN]木材[WHITE]才能修好

node.id: You set the final planks in their place and the bridge looks like new.
node.to: 最后一块木板放上去了，大桥看起来像新的一样

node.id: There is a train parked at the Central Railway Station that seems to be missing a power unit, rendering it inoperable until one can be found. Perhaps there is some info inside the [LOCATION=TRAIN_STATION_1]?
node.to: 中枢火车站停靠着一列火车，它似乎缺少一个动力装置，在找到之前我们无法运行。也许可以在[LOCATION=TRAIN_STATION_1]找到一些有用的信息

node.id: You insert the power cell into its place and can hear a low rumble emanate from the engine compartment. The train is ready and set to go.
node.to: 装好动力装置电池，可以听到发动机舱发出的低沉隆隆声，火车已经准备好出发了

node.id: Look around the [LOCATION=TRAIN_STATION_1] for clues on a power cell.
node.to: 在[LOCATION=TRAIN_STATION_1]附近查找动力装置电池的线索

node.id: Go to [LOCATION=SHOPPING_CENTRE_1] and find the delivery records.
node.to: 前往[LOCATION=SHOPPING_CENTRE_1] 查看投递记录

node.id: [GREEN]Locate[WHITE] the correct package with a [RED]Train Power Unit[WHITE] inside.
node.to: [GREEN]定位[WHITE]正确的包裹投递位置，[RED]火车动力装置电池[WHITE]就在包裹里
[GREEN]收好[WHITE] 这个 [RED]火车动力装置电池[WHITE]

node.id: [GREEN]Insert[WHITE] the [RED]Train Power Unit[WHITE] into the train at [LOCATION=TRAIN_STATION_1].
node.to: 将 [RED]火车动力装置电池[WHITE] [GREEN]装到[WHITE] [LOCATION=TRAIN_STATION_1]的火车上

node.id: The Crown Archaeological Expedition Team was investigating something important. Investigate the site.
node.to: 在考古现场，皇冠考古队正在调查一件重要的事情

node.id: The cost of the expedition was high, but it ended in a great discovery.
node.to: 远征的费用非常高昂，但最终探索到了一个伟大的发现

node.id: Find and listen to the second [ORANGE]Audio Log[WHITE].
node.to: 找到并收听第二个[ORANGE]音频日志[WHITE]

node.id: Find and listen to the third [ORANGE]Audio Log[WHITE].
node.to: 找到并收听第三个[ORANGE]音频日志[WHITE]

node.id: Find and listen to the Camp [ORANGE]Audio Log[WHITE].
node.to: 找到并收听营地的[ORANGE]音频日志[WHITE]

node.id: Travel to the [ORANGE]Archaeological Dig Site B[WHITE].
Find and listen to the expedition [ORANGE]Audio Log[WHITE].
node.to: 找到并收听远征队[ORANGE]音频日志[WHITE]

node.id: Find a way to open the passage.
node.to: 找到打开神殿入口通道办法

node.id: Find and listen to the Beachhead Station [ORANGE]Audio Log[WHITE].
node.to: 找到并收听滩头站的[ORANGE]音频日志[WHITE]

node.id: Follow the River and the Paths to the Beachhead Crew Camp.
node.to: 沿着河流和小路前往滩头营地

node.id: Find and listen to the Expedition [ORANGE]Audio Log[WHITE].
node.to: 找到并收听远征队的[ORANGE]音频日志[WHITE]

node.id: Follow the route through [ORANGE]Rocky Mountain Path[WHITE].
node.to: 沿着这条路线穿过[ORANGE]火山山道[WHITE]

node.id: Find and listen to the [ORANGE]Audio Log[WHITE].
Build Sawmills to accelerate your Lumber production.
node.to: 建造锯木机提高木头产量

node.id: A new Sawmill is now ready to use.

node.to: 发明和制作[GREEN]建筑工具包[WHITE]

node.id: Build Smelters to accelerate your Steel and Titanium production.
node.to: 建造冶炼机提高钢铁和钛的产量

node.id: A new metal Smelter is now ready to use.
An important convoy has gone missing. Perhaps it was carrying something valuable?
node.to: 一支重要的护航车队失踪了，它携带了一些贵重物品

node.id: The final vehicle seems to have crashed hard, but you still manage to salvage the important cargo.
node.to: 最后一辆车似乎撞得很厉害，不过还是要设法找到那些贵重物品

node.id: Reach the Checkpoint in [ORANGE]Sunburn Desert[WHITE] and look for clues once you arrive there.
node.to: 前往 [ORANGE]炙热沙漠[WHITE] 的检查站寻找线索

node.id: Follow the road towards [LOCATION=MINE_1] to locate the convoy.
node.to: 沿着道路前往[LOCATION=MINE_1] 并找到护航车队
检查位于[LOCATION=CONVOY_1] 的护航车队车辆

node.id: Investigate the area around [LOCATION=CONVOY_1] in detail.
Follow the tracks leading from the [LOCATION=CONVOY_1] and locate the missing vehicle.
node.to: 根据[LOCATION=CONVOY_1]调查的线索引导，找到丢失的车辆

node.id: Uncover the hidden wealth mentioned in the notes.
node.to: 揭开笔记中提到的隐藏财富的秘密

node.id: After uncovering a stash of valuables you can't help but to reflect a bit on human nature.
node.to: 找到财富藏匿处后，不由让人反思一下人性

node.id: [GREEN]Find[WHITE] the spot indicated in the photo.
Find the [GREEN]'white tree of our withered love.'[WHITE]
node.to: 找到[GREEN]枯萎凋谢的白色树[WHITE]

node.id: Dig at the northeastern corner of the tennis court.
node.to: 在网球场的东北角挖掘

node.id: Other mana rifts have opened in the world and are now safe to use
node.to: 其他神力裂缝已经在世界上打开，现在可以安全使用

node.id: You find a note on the table: They want my family recipe! Well they won't get it! I've locked the recipe away in the locker room. If you want to find it you have to [GREEN]follow the trash![WHITE]
node.to: 找到桌上的便条：他们想要我的家庭菜谱！但是他们拿不到！我已经将菜谱锁在房里。如果想要找到它，必须一路[GREEN]沿着垃圾[WHITE]寻找

node.id: The diner locker room is finally open and it seems like a small treasure trove, ready for you to plunder.
node.to: 餐厅的更衣室终于打开了，它看起来像一个小宝库，任你取掠

node.id: Check the diner back alley for.. [GREEN]trash[WHITE]?
node.to: 检查餐厅后巷里的 [GREEN]垃圾[WHITE]

node.id: Search through more trash [ORANGE]near a pond, North of diner[WHITE].
node.to: 在[ORANGE]餐厅北部池塘附近[WHITE]的垃圾堆中寻找线索

node.id: Dig the [GREEN]green ground[WHITE] between piles of trash at the [ORANGE]passages, South of Old Chalice[WHITE].
node.to: 在 [ORANGE]老圣杯镇以南的山路[WHITE]的垃圾堆中挖掘 [GREEN]绿色地面[WHITE]

node.id: Gain access to the [ORANGE]diner locker room[WHITE].
node.to: 进入[ORANGE]锁定的餐厅更衣室[WHITE]

node.id: Farming should be looked into, as growing crops can help you to get more ingredients for food.
node.to: 是时候研究一下农业种植了，种植作物可以帮你获得更多的食物原料

node.id: The first harvest is successful and promises a perpetual source of sustenance.
node.to: 第一次成功的收获，为以后得生计找到了好出路

node.id: Fish should still be safe to eat. Try and catch a few for the cooking recipes.
node.to: 鱼应该还是可以安全食用的，尝试钓一些鱼进行烹饪

node.id: Fishing seems like second nature to you.
The Link Tower in the area appears to be vandalised and broken. A note reveals that new parts can be found at [LOCATION=STEEL_MILL_1], west side of Narrows Vale.
node.to: 这个区域的链塔被破坏了，消息显示用于修复的零件可以在峡谷西部的[LOCATION=STEEL_MILL_1]找到

node.id: The twisted and broken supports have been replaced. You fixed the structure and the innards of the Link Tower.
node.to: 破碎的链塔已经修补好了，可以恢复正常使用

node.id: The terminal next to the wall appears broken and lifeless. Perhaps it can be fixed to gain access to beyond the wall?
node.to: 门边的终端设备被破坏了，也许可以修理好，这样就可以前往大门的另一边

node.id: After some tinkering, clever tool usage and a few electrical zaps, the terminal starts humming again and text appears on the screen.
node.to: 经过巧妙的使用一些工具进行焊接修补后，终端设备屏幕上出现一些文字

node.id: Bring the required materials with you and fix the [ORANGE]Terminal[WHITE] at [LOCATION=CHECKPOINT_1]
node.to: 带上所需的物资，修复位于[LOCATION=CHECKPOINT_1]的[ORANGE]终端[WHITE]

node.id: The terminal next to the wall appears to have short circuited. Probably something to do with the humidity of the area. Perhaps it can be fixed?
node.to: 可能是因为这个地区太潮湿了，门边的终端设备似乎出现短路，也许可以修好它

node.id: Turns out that the seals that were supposed to keep the electronics dry were faulty. You fixed both the seals and the innards of the terminal.
node.to: 应该是保持终端的干燥的密封部件出现了故障，修复密封条和内部设备

node.id: [GREEN]Bring[WHITE] the required materials with you and fix the [ORANGE]Terminal[WHITE] at [LOCATION=CHECKPOINT_2].
node.to: [GREEN]带上[WHITE]所需的物资，修好位于[LOCATION=CHECKPOINT_2]的[ORANGE]终端[WHITE]

node.id: You were always more of a baseball fan than a football fan. Put on your fan gear and play ball.
node.to: 与其说你是足球迷，不如说你是棒球迷。穿上你的装备来打球吧

node.id: It is the ninth inning and all bases are full of bodies.
node.to: 现在是第九局了，所有的垒上都堆满了尸体

node.id: According to the notes on the table the graveyard keeper was spooked by mysterious lights emanating from the back portion of the graveyard. He seems to have locked the gate and [GREEN]buried[WHITE] the key at the grave with [GREEN]'the largest tombstone around'[WHITE].
node.to: 根据桌上便条的信息，守墓人被墓地后院的神秘灯光吓得不轻。他锁住了后院大门，把钥匙[GREEN]埋在[WHITE]墓地区域[GREEN] 最大的墓碑边上[WHITE]

node.id: The key fits into the lock and with a resounding 'click' you are granted access further into the graveyard.
node.to: 钥匙可以插入锁中，只听“咔嗒”一声，你可以进入墓地了

node.id: Open the gate leading to the back of the [LOCATION=GRAVEYARD_1].
node.to: 打开通向墓地后院的大门

node.id: The field is infested with ex-humans. It is time to turn them into fertiliser.
node.to: 这个地区到处是变异类人怪，是时候重拳出击，一举清理，让它们化为大地的肥料了

node.id: Nature will take care of this problem now.
node.to: 剩下的大自然会解决这些的问题

node.id: Some basic equipment is needed to even have a chance of survival.
node.to: 只有做好一些必要准备，才有生存下去的机会

node.id: This is the start of a long journey, but thankfully the basics are in place now.
node.to: 这是一段漫长旅程的起始，所幸必要的准备现在已经搞定了
找到[ORANGE]链塔[WHITE]，激活[GREEN]地图[WHITE]功能

node.id: Dig up the stashes on the map.
node.to: 在地图上挖掘隐藏的宝藏

node.id: You can't help but to wonder if there are more hidden treasures such as these.
node.to: 你不禁想知道，是否还有更多像这样的隐藏宝藏

node.id: Clear the basketball field from enemies in 60 seconds.
node.to: 在60秒内清理球场的敌人

node.id: The basketball court is quiet once more.
This world seems dangerous. To survive you need to further equip yourself.
node.to: 在这个危险的世界，如果想生存下去，就需要更好装备让自己变得更强

node.id: These measures will suffice for now.
The monsters in this area are reanimated each time you rest at a campfire. There must be a way to stop that from happening.
node.to: 每当你在篝火旁休息时，这个地区的怪物就会复活。必须想办法阻止这种情况的发生

node.id: Monsters won't respawn again on this Link Tower area.
node.to: 怪物将不会在链接塔区域再次重生
发明和制作 [GREEN]链塔工具包[WHITE]
在任意一个[ORANGE]链塔[WHITE]上安装[GREEN]致命信号[WHITE]

node.id: There is a note on top of empty boxes: The items were delivered to the location as requested. Apparently they are really good at keeping the heat in control. Can we have some of them too?
node.to: 空箱子顶部有一张纸条：物品已按要求送达地点。显然他们非常善于控制热量，我们也可以获得吗？

node.id: The Desert Helmet is now yours to craft. It will help you on the scorching wastelands.
node.to: 现在可以制作沙漠头盔了，它将帮助你在灼热的荒原上更好的生存

node.id: [GREEN]Search[WHITE] for more information about the 'cooling items'.
node.to: [GREEN]搜查[WHITE]以获取更多关于“降温物品”的信息

node.id: Travel to [LOCATION=SOLARIS_FARM] located at eastern part of the desert
Acquire the [GREEN]Desert Helmet[WHITE] recipe from the [ORANGE]Van[WHITE].
node.to: 搜查 [ORANGE]货车[WHITE] 获得[GREEN]沙漠头盔 [WHITE]的图谱

node.id: The loudspeaker claims that all surviving humans should head to the Pioneer's Park in the middle of the city. Perhaps you should head there too?
node.to: 扬声器里广播说，所有幸存者都应该前往市中心的先驱公园，也许你也应该去那里？

node.id: There are no other living humans in Central. Perhaps this holds true for the whole island?
node.to: 中枢已经没有人活着了，也许整个岛屿都是

node.id: Evade the turrets and get inside [LOCATION=PARK_1].
Look for [GREEN]clues[WHITE] about what happened [ORANGE]in the park.[WHITE]
node.to: 寻找[ORANGE]公园[WHITE]里发生的事件的[GREEN]线索[WHITE]

node.id: Find the means of escaping this wretched place.
node.to: 找到办法逃离这个该死的地方

node.id: Go to the evacuation site [GREEN]east[WHITE] of your shelter.
node.to: 前往庇护所以[GREEN]东[WHITE]的撤离现场

node.id: Get the gate open to gain access to the launch pads.
Link network needs to be online for the gate to open.
node.to: 需要连通继电器才能打开大门

node.id: Use the [GREEN]Link Tower[WHITE] to scan for [GREEN]Fuel Cells[WHITE].
node.to: 使用[GREEN]链塔[WHITE]扫描[GREEN]燃料电池[WHITE]的位置

node.id: Find and collect [GREEN]Fuel Cells[WHITE] for the escape pod.
node.to: 寻找和收集逃生舱的[GREEN]燃料电池[WHITE]

node.id: Install [GREEN]Fuel Cells[WHITE] to the escape pod.
node.to: 安装逃生舱的[GREEN]燃料电池[WHITE]

node.id: Find the [ORANGE]Escape Pod[WHITE] at the [ORANGE]Crown Station[WHITE].
node.to: 找到位于 [ORANGE]王冠站[WHITE] 的 [ORANGE]逃生舱[WHITE]

node.id: Make final preparations for the trip.
Mana is too precious to leave behind. Load the Escape Pod with some Mana Shards.
node.to: 神力太珍贵了，在逃生舱中装载一些神力碎片
装入[GREEN]神力碎片[WHITE] 到 [ORANGE]逃生舱[WHITE]

node.id: Say goodbyes and board the [ORANGE]Escape Pod[WHITE].
There is a building locked with a [RED]keycode[WHITE] behind the log mansion. You should search for the code inside the [LOCATION=HOUSE_15].
node.to: 在 [LOCATION=HOUSE_15] 找到后院小屋的 [RED]密码锁[WHITE] 密码

node.id: The reinforced building behind the [LOCATION=HOUSE_15] is open. What might be inside?
node.to: [LOCATION=HOUSE_15] 后院的加固建筑被锁住了，里面会有什么？

node.id: Search for the [RED]code[WHITE] inside the mansion.
node.to: 在宅邸里找到正确的 [RED]密码[WHITE]

node.id: The slimy and guttural sounds intensify around you. Ex-humans aren't the only danger around these parts.
node.to: 四周回荡着低沉的吼声，除了变异类人生物这里还充斥着更多危险

node.id: The foul stench of acid slowly starts to dissipate and you start breathing a little lighter. It is over.
node.to: 恶臭的酸液逐渐消散，呼吸也变得顺畅了一些，一切都结束了

node.id: There is a lone notebook page on the ground: One of the guests is reportedly acting suspiciously. She has been seen moving valuable looking items around, maybe even contraband. \n The [ORANGE]motel's Office[WHITE] should have the guest and room info.
node.to: 地上的一页笔记写着：其中一位客人的行为非常可疑。有人看到她四处搬动物品，甚至可能是藏了违禁品 \n[ORANGE]汽车旅馆的办公室[WHITE] 应该有客人和房间的信息

node.id: The misplaced getaway car's door unlocks. After pulling the rusted door open, you gain access to the spoils of the crime.
node.to: 打开汽车生锈的门，就可以获得可疑之人私藏的贵重物品

node.id: [GREEN]Search[WHITE] the [ORANGE]Motel Office[WHITE] for the room number
node.to: 在[ORANGE]汽车旅馆办公室[WHITE] [GREEN]找到[WHITE] 房间号的线索

node.id: [GREEN]Locate[WHITE] the correct room and [GREEN]Search[WHITE] for valuables
node.to: [GREEN]找到[WHITE]正确的房间，并[GREEN]搜索[WHITE]有价值的物品

node.id: [GREEN]Search[WHITE] for the car key in the [ORANGE]Motel Office Toilet[WHITE].
node.to: 在 [ORANGE]汽车旅馆办公室厕所[WHITE] [GREEN]找到[WHITE]汽车钥匙的位置

node.id: Search for the location of the car at the [ORANGE]Parking Lot, at West Underfield[WHITE].
node.to: 在 [ORANGE]安德菲尔德以西的停车场[WHITE] 找到汽车

node.id: Travel to [ORANGE]Fincher's Auto Salvage[WHITE] North Of Underfield.
node.to: 前往安德菲尔德北边的 [ORANGE]芬奇废旧汽车回收场[WHITE]

node.id: [GREEN]Search[WHITE] for more hints on what the car looks like.

node.to: [GREEN]找到[WHITE]一辆 [ORANGE]黄色[WHITE] 的面包车

node.id: Figure out what happened to the ancient island tribe.
node.to: 搞清楚远古时期的岛屿部落到底发生了什么

node.id: The island tribe seems to have perished because of the Pestilence.
node.to: 岛屿的部落似乎因为瘟疫而灭亡了
找到并且查明这些 [ORANGE]神秘石碑[WHITE]

node.id: A sturdy locomotive stands next to you. Upon closer inspection it seems to be missing some important mechanical parts and is thus inoperable. An attached note mentions a lost shipment of parts and a place name: [ORANGE]Solaris[WHITE]. Perhaps you should look there?
node.to: 经过仔细检查，停在旁边火车似乎缺失了一些重要的机械部件而无法正常运行。随附的说明中提到了一批丢失的零件和一个地名 [ORANGE]索拉里斯星[WHITE]，也许你应该去那里找找

node.id: The train valiantly plowed through the obstacles and carried you through the scorching desert.
node.to: 火车一路冲破障碍，载着你穿越灼热的沙漠
[GREEN]找到[WHITE] 维修零件修理 [ORANGE]沙漠列车[WHITE]
[GREEN]修理[WHITE] 位于 [LOCATION=MINE_1] 处的火车
点亮[ORANGE]索拉里斯星的火车站营地[WHITE]

node.id: The rocky passage you are traversing seems suspiciously quiet. The perfect place for an ambush.
node.to: 这个山间小路似乎安静得令人生疑，这是个绝佳的伏击点

node.id: There is blood on the snow, luckily it is not yours.
node.to: 雪地上隐约可见鲜血的痕迹，还好不是你的

node.id: There is a note in the dossier: 'Hey guys, it seems I forgot the key in the pocket of my pants. My wife must've put them in the [GREEN]washing machine[WHITE] so it seems the shipment will be late. Sorry!'
node.to: 档案里有一张纸条：“嘿，伙计们，我好像把钥匙忘在裤子口袋里了。我妻子一定把它们放进 [GREEN]洗衣机[WHITE] 里了，看来发货要延期了，非常抱歉！”

node.id: The key unlocks a door leading to a storage full of materials. One man's misfortune seems to be another man's fortune.
node.to: 钥匙看来是用来打开储存物料的仓库大门的。一人的不幸恰好成了另一个人的幸运

node.id: Get inside of the locked storage in [LOCATION=TOWN_2].
node.to: 进入位于 [LOCATION=TOWN_2] 的上锁仓库

node.id: The place you are heading for is extremely cold and you will not survive there for extended periods of time without proper equipment.
node.to: 即将前往的地方非常寒冷，如果没有合适的装备，将无法长时间生存

node.id: You feel confident in embarking upon the next step of your journey.
node.to: 你已经信心满满踏上了下一步旅程
发明和制作 [GREEN]保温热水袋[WHITE]
点亮[ORANGE]北极星的源泉火车站营地[WHITE]

node.id: A Small Key Opens Big Doors
A Gate blocks the way to a mysterious pit crackling with strange energy. Find a way to get it open.
node.to: 一扇大门挡住了通往神秘能量天坑的路，需要想办法打开它

node.id: The Polaris Gate is now open. What could lie beyond it?
node.to: 北极星大门打开了，里面会有什么呢？

node.id: Look around for a way to open the gate.
Look for the Polaris Gate Key.
Find out where the General went
Go to the [ORANGE]Link Tower[WHITE] and open the Polaris Gate from there.
node.to: 前往 [ORANGE]北极星链塔[WHITE]，并在那里打开北极星大门

node.id: During an evacuation mission at [LOCATION=HARBOR_1] on the Western Coast, the police seem to have lost some equipment. Perhaps you could salvage some of it?
node.to: 在 [LOCATION=HARBOR_1] 执行疏散任务时，警方丢失了一些装备。也许你可以帮忙取回？

node.id: While the gear you found was in shambles, you should be able to reverse engineer something out of them.
node.to: 找到的装备看样子很糟糕，你应该可以修理好

node.id: Search for signs of police inside the [LOCATION=HARBOR_1]
node.to: 在 [LOCATION=HARBOR_1] 附近搜索警车留下的线索

node.id: Retrieve the lost riot equipment at [LOCATION=HARBOR_2]
node.to: 在 [LOCATION=HARBOR_2] 找回丢失的防爆装备

node.id: Air gets colder and there is snow all around. Invent something that will keep you warm.
node.to: 天气越来越冷了，到处在下雪，应该发明和制作一些保暖的装备

node.id: Although the air never gets warmer, your body is now protected against the elements.
node.to: 虽然天气不会因此变暖，但起码你的身体现在受到了保护，不再受这该死的恶劣天气影响了

node.id: Invent a [GREEN]Fur Hat[WHITE] or a [GREEN]Hot Water Bottle[WHITE] .
node.to: 发明和制作 [GREEN]裘皮帽[WHITE] 或 [GREEN]保温热水袋[WHITE]

node.id: The gate that leads further into the prison has been locked. [GREEN]Search for the key[WHITE] around other parts of the building.
node.to: 通往监狱的大门已经锁上了，在其他地区的建筑离 [GREEN]寻找钥匙[WHITE]

node.id: The gate is open, but eerie sounds reverberate around the barren walls.
node.to: 门打开了，但四周回荡着诡异的声音

node.id: Search through the [LOCATION=PRISON_1] admin wing for a key.
node.to: 寻找 [LOCATION=PRISON_1] 管理室的钥匙
前往 [ORANGE]柯蒂斯菲尔德北部[WHITE]

node.id: [GREEN]Search[WHITE] for the key inside the [ORANGE]police station[WHITE].
node.to: 进入 [GREEN]警察局[WHITE] [GREEN]搜索[WHITE] 钥匙

node.id: Open the locked gate and enter the [LOCATION=PRISON_1]
A bunch of welcoming and friendly messages promise a [GREEN]Sanctuary[WHITE]. Perhaps there are other people there?
node.to: 一堆热情友好的欢迎信息信誓旦旦的表示附近有一个 [GREEN]庇护所[WHITE]，也许那里还有其他幸存者？

node.id: The promise of a [GREEN]Sanctuary[WHITE] was just a tall tale to lure travelers into a trap schemed by a long gone Villain. At least those traveler's belongings won't go to waste.
node.to: [GREEN]庇护所[WHITE]的消息只是一个恶棍诱导人前往的骗局，意图显然是想掠夺那些受骗的旅行者的财物
跟随路标前往 [ORANGE]"农场庇护所"[WHITE]

node.id: [GREEN]Locate[WHITE] the [ORANGE]"Pond of Crows"[WHITE] by following the Creek
node.to: 沿着小溪 [GREEN]找到[WHITE] [ORANGE]"乌鸦池塘"[WHITE]

node.id: [GREEN]Find[WHITE] the [ORANGE]"Skull Trees"[WHITE] and what is placed there
node.to: [GREEN]找到[WHITE] [ORANGE]"骷髅树"[WHITE] 看看有什么

node.id: There is an invitational letter on the table: 'Participate in the yearly Scavenger Hunt! First up you need to find a [GREEN]green[WHITE] coffee maker, then you'll get the next clue!'
node.to: 桌子上有一封邀请信：“欢迎参加一年一度的有寻宝活动。首先要找到一台 [GREEN]绿色[WHITE] 咖啡机，然后就会得到下一条线索！”

node.id: After a long journey locating specific objects, you are rewarded with a pretty handsome reward!
node.to: 经过漫长的寻宝过程，您将获得非常丰富的奖励！
在 [LOCATION=TOWN_14] 找到一台 [GREEN]绿色[WHITE] 咖啡机
在 [LOCATION=TOWN_14] 找到一台 [GREEN]红色[WHITE] 电视机
在 [LOCATION=TOWN_14] 找到一台 [GREEN]蓝色[WHITE] 暖气片
在 [LOCATION=TOWN_14] 西南方找到一块 [GREEN]橙色[WHITE] 的墓碑

node.id: Find a |#ffce77|Yellow[WHITE] Grandfather Clock far Northwest of [LOCATION=TOWN_14].
node.to: 在 [LOCATION=TOWN_14] 西北方找到一个 |#ffce77|黄色[WHITE] 祖父钟

node.id: Dig up the reward west of the [LOCATION=HOUSE_9], between two rocks
node.to: 在 [LOCATION=HOUSE_9] 西部的两块石头之间挖掘奖励

node.id: The loud sounds from the speaker attracts the monsters out from the [ORANGE]old shelter[WHITE] nearby. Build defenses and kill all the monsters before they reach the loudspeaker.
node.to: 扬声器发出的巨响把怪物从 [ORANGE]废弃庇护所[WHITE]吸引了出来。建立防御工事，在怪物到达扬声器前杀死它们

node.id: The old shelters are a good source of rare materials.
node.to: 废弃的地下庇护所有很多稀有材料
消灭所有从庇护所涌出的怪物

node.id: Further down south the air and overall climate get damp and tropical. Protect yourself against the hostile climate.
node.to: 越往南走天气也变得越炎热，要做好预防炎热的准备

node.id: The heat does not falter you any more.
node.to: 高温再也伤害不到你了

node.id: Invent a [GREEN]Cowboy Hat[WHITE] or an [GREEN]Ice Brick[WHITE] .
node.to: 发明和制作 [GREEN]牛仔帽[WHITE] 或 [GREEN]降温冰块[WHITE]

node.id: There is a strange doorway in the middle of the military base. It is currently inaccessible. What could be inside?
node.to: 在军事基地的中间有一个奇怪的门，当前还无法进入，里面会有什么呢？

node.id: Few lights at the side of the door turn on and your ears pick up a gentle humming noise. The doorway is now open.
node.to: 门边透着微弱的灯光，耳边传来嗡嗡的响声，门现在打开了

node.id: The village you have entered seems quiet. Perhaps this would be a good place to test out those [RED][ITEM_NAME=[VAR.item_id]][WHITE] you have crafted.
node.to: 这个村庄似乎很安静，也许这是个测试你制作的 [RED][ITEM_NAME=[VAR.item_id]][WHITE] 的好地方

node.id: A moment of clarity follows after the bloodlust subsides. Was that really necessary?
node.to: 嗜血的欲望逐渐消退，随之而来的清醒让你思考真的有必要这样吗？

node.id: Upgrade the crowbar tool and break through the obstacles.
The way is open now for you to proceed forwards.
node.to: 现在你可以继续前进了

node.id: Upgrade the crowbar at the camp
node.to: 前往营地升级撬棍等级

node.id: Fabricators can be used to create items directly from materials.
node.to: 制造机可以将材料加工成道具
制造机已准备好可使用

node.id: Use The Fabricator to [GREEN]Fabricate[WHITE] an item.
Hungry howls echo in the freezing wind. The howls are getting closer.
node.to: 寒风中充斥着饥渴的嚎叫，咆哮声越来越近

node.id: The last whimper dies out and silence follows.
node.to: 最后呜咽声也消失了，随之而来的是死一般的寂静
将近一半的人已经撤离了

node.id: The flipboard contains a |#7777ff|recipe|#ffffff| of something... magnificient. I need to find more of these sketches before I can |#00ff00|fabricate|#ffffff| this.
node.to: 速写板上写有一些...重要的 |#7777ff|图谱|#ffffff|，我们需要找到更多才可以 |#00ff00|制造|#ffffff|

node.id: Sleep to pass time and get a temporary |#11ff11|Rest Bonus|#ffffff|.
node.to: 睡觉可以加速时间，并获得临时的 |#11ff11|属性奖励|#ffffff|
亲爱的 苏 和 杰米：

node.id: Last night when you were asleep, I buried some valuables outside our house. That's just in case they come back searching again. If I'm not back by Sunday, use the stuff to barter your ticket to the evacuation transport. I'm sure they'll listen to reason.
node.to: 为了防止它们再次回来寻找，昨晚在你睡着的时候我将一些贵重物品埋在了屋外。如果我星期天还没回来，就用这些东西去交换撤离的车票，我相信他们会跟你们交换的

node.id: Find Recipes to craft new equipment.
node.to: 发现制作新道具的图谱

node.id: Find a |#11ff11|Plant Bed|#ffffff| to plant the seed in. Use |#11ff11|Hoe|#ffffff| to create Plant Beds.
node.to: 找到 |#11ff11|可种植的土地|#ffffff| 或者使用 |#11ff11|锄头|#ffffff| 翻土让土地适合种植

node.id: Return when the requirements are met.

node.to: 显示|#00ff00|已激活|#ffffff| 的兴趣点

node.id: Install Transmitters to have effects over the Link Tower area.
node.to: 安装发射器让链塔区域覆盖信号

node.id: WARNING: Unable to save game at the moment. Joining will reload latest save.
node.to: 警告：目前无法保存游戏。加入将重新加载最近的存档

node.id: Swipe UP to move gems up.
node.to: 向上滑动 将物品向上移动

node.id: Swipe RIGHT to move gems right.
node.to: 向右滑动 将物品向右移动

node.id: Press UP to move gems up.
node.to: 按住上键 将物品向上移动

node.id: Press RIGHT to move gems right.
node.to: 按住右键 将物品向右移动

node.id: Figure out how to combine the two gems.
Now each time you move a new gem appears.
GAME OVER - Press any button to restart.
node.to: 游戏结束 - 按任意按钮重新开始

node.id: Note that you can change these any time in the options menu.
node.to: 您可以在菜单种随时更改这些选项

node.id: Upgrade this campfire for various benefits.
node.to: 升级营地获得更多好处

node.id: Warm and fuzzy hat that against cold damage when worn.
node.to: 保暖的毛绒帽，戴上后可防止寒冷伤害

node.id: Fight and survive with your bare hands.
A powerful totem of the mighty bull.
A jury rigged battery will enhance weapons with shocking power.

node.to: 给你超高的极寒和酷热容忍度

node.id: Allows you access to otherwise forbidden places.

node.to: 装备好后可以骑上小马

node.id: A four legged, hoofed mammal that consumes plants for its sustenance.
node.to: 四足有蹄哺乳动物，以植物为食

node.id: A young specimen of a four legged, hoofed mammal that consumes plants for its sustenance.
node.to: 一种年幼的四足有蹄哺乳动物，以植物为食

node.id: The twisted, snarling king of the frostbitten north.
The brawler is both larger and more vicious than the scrapper it has clearly evolved from.
This evolved ranged enemy has gathered a small following.
node.to: 这个进化后的远程敌人已经聚集了一小波追随者

node.id: A tireless, blood crazed pursuant with a deadly rending claw.
node.to: 一个不知疲倦的疯狂敌人，以致命撕裂的爪子攻击

node.id: A deadly variant of the Stalker, this Skulker is small, fast and extremely agile.
node.to: 一种致命的追猎者变种，具有体积小，速度快，极其敏捷的特征

node.id: This lumbering behemoth is slow, but capable of destroying humans with ease.
node.to: 这个笨重的庞然大物行动缓慢，但能够轻而易举地杀死人类

node.id: Once a majestic hunter of the wild, the Ex-Wolf is now nothing more than a cruel diseased beast.
node.to: 这个曾经威严的猎人已经变成了一个愚蠢的怪物

node.id: A lifetime spent running from the long arm of the law has made the Chaser very resourceful in pursuing fleeing prey.
node.to: 这个怪物一生都在逃避法律的制裁，练就了狡猾无比的特性

node.id: A melee oriented ex-human that finds strength in numbers but is relatively harmless by itself.
node.to: 这个怪物使用不同类型的近战攻击目标

node.id: The Hurler could well have been a professional athlete in the past. The projectiles it lobs towards enemies are both accurate and deadly.
node.to: 这个怪物更喜欢远程方式，向猎物投掷有毒的炮弹

node.id: The Puker is able to produce incredible amounts of toxic sludge internally that it will then expel upon hapless victims making them easier to digest.
node.to: 这个怪物有很高的血量，并在战斗中排出有毒液体

node.id: The Stalker has shed more of its former humanity than most ex-humans, trading it for savage ferocity and an endless thirst for blood.
node.to: 高度危险，这个快速致命的怪物嗜血成性

node.id: A mutated form of a flower that spits toxic sludge when it senses living forms nearby.
node.to: 一种变异的花朵，当它感觉到附近有生命时会吐出淤泥毒液

node.id: A mutated form of a plant that impales prey next to it with its massive spikes.
node.to: 一种变异的植物，用它巨大的钉刺刺穿靠近的猎物

node.id: I need [REQUIRED_MATERIALS] to fix this arcade cabinet.
node.to: 我需要[REQUIRED_MATERIALS]来修理这个拱廊橱柜

node.id: Where could I find electronics components [EMOJI=thinking face]
node.to: 我在哪能找到电子元件[EMOJI=thinking face]

node.id: I don't remember seeing these obelisks ever before on the island.
node.to: 我不记得以前在岛上见过这些方尖碑

node.id: I don't have enough with me.
The gate is [GREEN]sealed[WHITE] until nearby threats are removed.
node.to: 大门 [GREEN]被封锁[WHITE] 直到附近危险被消除
答对了！这就是我的求生之道 [EMOJI=star-struck]

node.id: It looks old, but it's essentially intact. I wonder why they left this one behind. [EMOJI=thinking face]
node.to: 它看起来很旧，但基本上完好无损。我想知道他们为什么把它丢下 [EMOJI=thinking face]

node.id: It's missing four [MATERIAL_ICON=FUEL_CELL] [GREEN]Fuel Cells[WHITE] though. I should be able to scan for those using a [GREEN]Link Tower[WHITE]. [EMOJI=thinking face]
node.to: 缺失了四个 [MATERIAL_ICON=FUEL_CELL] [GREEN]燃料电池[WHITE]，我想可以通过 [GREEN]链塔[WHITE] 扫描电池的位置 [EMOJI=thinking face]
让我们安装好这些东西

node.id: I need to find a [MATERIAL_ICON=FUEL_CELL] Fuel Cell.
node.to: 我需要找到 [MATERIAL_ICON=FUEL_CELL] 燃料电池

node.id: I should build some defences first. Who knows how many monsters will come out of that old shelter.
node.to: 我应该先建一些防御工事，鬼知道有多少怪物会从那个废弃避难所里爬出来

node.id: The gas is getting to my lungs. I need [GREEN]Gas Mask[WHITE].
node.to: 毒气正在侵入的肺部，我需要佩戴 [GREEN]毒气面罩[WHITE]

node.id: I need [REQUIRED_MATERIALS] to fix this terminal.
node.to: 我需要 [REQUIRED_MATERIALS] 来修理这个终端

node.id: The [GREEN]Link Relay[WHITE] is now back online. [GREEN]Three[WHITE] more to go.
node.to: 这个 [GREEN]继电器[WHITE] 连上了，还有 [GREEN]三个[WHITE] 需要去激活

node.id: Makes you wonder why these relays were specifically disabled though. [EMOJI=thinking face]
node.to: 我想知道为什么这些继电器被禁用了 [EMOJI=thinking face]

node.id: Another [GREEN]Link Relay[WHITE] back online. Making good progress.
node.to: 另一个 [GREEN]继电器[WHITE] 也已经恢复连接，进展不错

node.id: Only one more to go! Still wondering why the [EMOJI=crown] [ORANGE]Crown Station[WHITE] had been cut off from this network.. [EMOJI=face with raised eyebrow]
node.to: 只剩一个了！想知道为什么[EMOJI=crown] [ORANGE]皇冠站[WHITE] 脱离了网络连接…[EMOJI=face with raised eyebrow]

node.id: What could have happened there? [EMOJI=thinking face]
That's the last [GREEN]Link Relay[WHITE] [EMOJI=victory hand] Now back to that gate at [LOCATION=EVACUATION_SITE]!
node.to: 这是最后一个 [GREEN]继电器[WHITE] [EMOJI=victory hand]，现在需要回到 [LOCATION=EVACUATION_SITE] 大门口!

node.id: Not sure what to do with this yet. I should investigate the [ORANGE]Evacuation Site[WHITE].
node.to: 还不知道该怎么办。我应该调查 [ORANGE]撤离现场[WHITE]

node.id: Create lumber out of scrap wood.
Melt and refine metal into more valuable alloys.
Locked since what? When does it reset? [EMOJI=thinking face]
node.to: 什么时候锁定？ 什么时候重置？[EMOJI=thinking face]

node.id: I'm not carrying those materials right now [EMOJI=thinking face]
node.to: 现在身上没有携带这些物品 [EMOJI=thinking face]

node.id: I should come back with [REQUESTED_MATERIALS] later [EMOJI=thinking face]
node.to: 我应该稍后随身带着 [REQUESTED_MATERIALS] 回来 [EMOJI=thinking face]

node.id: Where could I find those materials [EMOJI=thinking face]
node.to: 我应该去什么地方找到这些物料 [EMOJI=thinking face]

node.id: Craft a [ORANGE]Cooking Pot[WHITE] to start cooking.
node.to: 发明和制作 [ORANGE]烹饪锅[WHITE] 开始烹饪

node.id: Find [ORANGE]Cooking Recipes[WHITE] and craft a [ORANGE]Cooking Pot[WHITE] to start cooking.
node.to: 找到 [ORANGE]食谱[WHITE] 并且发明制作 [ORANGE]烹饪锅[WHITE] 开始烹饪

node.id: No one's there [EMOJI=face with rolling eyes]
node.to: 没有人在那里 [EMOJI=face with rolling eyes]

node.id: I need [REQUIRED_MATERIALS] to fix this bridge.
node.to: 我需要 [REQUIRED_MATERIALS] 来修复桥梁

node.id: That sawmill I saw back there could be handy [EMOJI=thinking face]
node.to: 或许那个锯木机应该很有用 [EMOJI=thinking face]

node.id: I can hear monsters inside. I should lure them out before entering. [EMOJI=thinking face]
node.to: 我能听到里面有怪物的声音，我应该在进去之前先把它们引诱出来消灭掉 [EMOJI=thinking face]

node.id: "We have been holed up in this park for two weeks now. Two weeks of mindless slaughter.."
node.to: "这两周外面正经历无数盲目的屠杀，这段时间我们只能躲在这个公园里"

node.id: "If you find my wife, please tell her that I am sorry for everything."
node.to: "如果你看到我妻子，替我向他说声抱歉"

node.id: The situation is untenable, we need to evacuate people to Crown via the Undercrown passage behind the city hall and destroy the entryway behind us.
node.to: 这种情况撑不了多久，我们需要通过市政厅后面的地下通道疏散人们进入皇冠后，并摧毁入口

node.id: "Is this just the inevitable conclusion of everything despite my best efforts?"
node.to: "尽管我尽了最大的努力，这就是一切的必然结果吗？"

node.id: "Once the last of the civilians are through, you are to destroy the supports and collapse the tunnel behind them."
node.to: "一旦最后一个平民通过，你就要炸毁背后的隧道"

node.id: This path is blocked. Perhaps there is a way around?
node.to: 这条路已经被炸毁，也许还有其它的路？

node.id: The trail of police cars leads this way. Where is this bridge heading to?
node.to: 警车的踪迹就在这条路上，这座桥又通向何处？

node.id: Central Main Power Plant. No loitering!
"A delivery man from the [LOCATION=SHOPPING_CENTRE_1] told us that he misdelivered our power cell."
node.to: " [LOCATION=SHOPPING_CENTRE_1] 的送货员告诉我们，他把我们的动力电池送错地方了"

node.id: "Remind me why is it that a critical part of our transport infrastructure is at the hands of a store?"
node.to: "为什么我们的交通基础设施的关键部分掌握在商场手中？"

node.id: "Until further notice, all arriving and departing train lines have been closed."
node.to: "在获得另行通知之前，所有进出站的列车均已停运"

node.id: I think this is the correct package!
node.to: 我想这个就是正确的包裹

node.id: "As a lot of workers have reported in sick. The rest you need to pick up the slack!
node.to: "因为很多工人都提了病假，只剩下你来收拾残局了"

node.id: SHOP CLOSED! Won't likely come back any time soon.
node.to: 商店关门了！不太可能很快恢复营业

node.id: There is an odious smell lingering in here..
node.to: 一股难闻的气味充斥于此

node.id: Now to finally find that lost equipment!
node.to: 终于找到了丢失的装备！

node.id: What is that house? It sure is ..personal.
node.to: 那是什么房子？当然是…私人的

node.id: They laughed at me when I said I was going to build a house completely by myself.
node.to: 当我说我要自己一个人盖房子时，他们都嘲笑我

node.id: Who is laughing now, I ask?
"Selling a couple of stacks of good planks and a sawmill due to not needing them anymore."
node.to: "因为不再需要木材和锯木机，就卖掉了一些"

node.id: "Has anybody else noticed voices from that supposedly empty apartment?"
node.to: "有没有其他人注意到那个空荡荡的公寓里传出来的声音"

node.id: "Please don't shave yourself in the shower. It is really nasty cleaning that stuff up."
node.to: "请不要在淋浴时刮胡子，该死的胡渣子也太难清理了"

node.id: Grabowski Gym - Find your inner muscle!
node.to: 健身房 - 锻炼出你的肌肉！

node.id: This seems to be fern real!
node.to: 这好像是真的蕨类植被！

node.id: Ewww.. dumping chemicals like this has got to have been illegal!

node.id: and.. what is that thing in the middle? [EMOJI=grimacing face]
node.to: 中间那东西是什么？[EMOJI=grimacing face]

node.id: No trespassing! This area is guarded.
These seem like some random notes and scribblings related to some computer software.

node.id: "The situation outside is pretty dire, but it does offer some ideas for our future projects."
node.to: "外面的形势相当严峻，但它确实为我们未来的项目提供了一些思路"

node.id: ''For the memory of the native inhabitants of the island. Original artifacts as discovered in 1917.''

node.id: The dog is not home. [EMOJI=thinking face]
Another perfect campfire, but no one in sight. Strange. [EMOJI=thinking face]

node.id: This seems like an administrative building.

node.id: Central has fallen. Only death awaits you here.

node.id: Wonder what happened to him? [EMOJI=thinking face]
Office & Launch Area. Unauthorized access forbidden

珍妮的堡垒！未经允许，禁止擅入！

That monster looks [RED]extremely dangerous[WHITE]. I should be careful so it doesn't see me. [EMOJI=face screaming in fear]

A secret room? There must be something important behind this wall.

node.id: Found it. Nobody respects the woods anymore.
node.to: 找到了，再也没有人尊重森林了

node.id: Are these holes meant for keeping the place safe? [EMOJI=flushed face]
node.to: 这些陷阱是用来保护这个地方安全的吗？[EMOJI=flushed face]

node.id: The Car is not here.. [EMOJI=thinking face]
Due to the ongoing events, all deliveries are currently delayed.
node.to: 目前所有交货都被推迟了

node.id: Roadside barbeque and fishing. Catch your own fish steak!
node.to: 路边烧烤和钓鱼，然后自制鱼排！

node.id: Wonder what happened to these people?
Remember to check the [ORANGE]Mailbox[WHITE] for the response about the [GREEN]Desert Hats[WHITE].
node.to: 请记得查看 [ORANGE]信箱[WHITE]，以获取有关 [GREEN]沙漠头盔[WHITE] 的信件

node.id: The best barbeque in the whole region! What is the secret ingredient? We'd love to tell you, but can't!
node.to: 整个地区最好的烧烤！秘方是什么？我们很想告诉你，但我不能！

node.id: Today is finally the day I am able to test my new explosive compound. First, just a few minor tweaks to the formula and we're set!
node.to: 今天我终于可以测试我的新炸药了，首先只需对公式进行一些小的调整，我们就可以开始了

node.id: There's another note: 'Here's the key. The car is at a [ORANGE]Parking Lot at West Underfield.[WHITE]' [EMOJI=face with raised eyebrow]
node.to: 还有另外一张纸条写着：“这是钥匙，车子就在 [ORANGE]西边的安德菲尔德停车场[WHITE]” [EMOJI=face with raised eyebrow]

node.id: That's one dirty bed. Nothing here. [EMOJI=neutral face]
node.to: 只有一张脏兮兮的床，其它什么都没有 [EMOJI=neutral face]
恶心，黏糊糊的！[EMOJI=face vomiting] 这里什么都没有

node.id: There is a hidden note behind the painting:\n 'Dear accomplice. The items are getting a bit too hot to keep here. I've stashed the car key and location behind the [ORANGE]Office Toilet Seat[WHITE]. Meet me later.'
node.to: 这幅画后面藏着一张字条：\n亲爱的伙伴，这些东西太棘手了，我把车钥匙藏在 [ORANGE]办公室马桶[WHITE] 后面了，待会儿见

node.id: You find a crumpled note: "My darling, I found the guard snooping around. He has been taken care of."
node.to: 你发现一张皱巴巴的碎纸条："亲爱的，我发现警卫正在四处窥探着什么"

node.id: "Just to be sure, I moved the stash to a different place. Hint is at the [GREEN]white tree of our withered love.[WHITE]"
node.to: "只是确定一下，我把藏匿的物品挪到了另一个地方。暗示是在那棵 [GREEN]枯萎凋谢的白色树下[WHITE]"

node.id: It seems like one of the vehicles escaped this massacre. It must've been the one carrying [GREEN]the important cargo[WHITE]!
node.to: 似乎其中一辆车逃过了这场屠杀，一定就是那辆 [GREEN]运送贵重物品的车[WHITE]！

node.id: I better follow the tracks through the desert!
node.to: 我最好沿着小路穿过沙漠！

node.id: Only some clutter and broken boxes here.
node.to: 这里只有一些杂物和破箱子

node.id: It seems like the convoy originated from [LOCATION=MINE_1]. Where is that? Are there road signs nearby? [EMOJI=thinking face]
node.to: 看来车队来自 [LOCATION=MINE_1]，那是哪里？附近有路标吗？[EMOJI=thinking face]

node.id: Seems like there was a point to this in the end!
node.to: 看来这最终是有意义的！

node.id: I can't find anything of value from the vehicles. Perhaps there was something I missed?
node.to: 我在车上找不到任何有价值的东西，或许是我错过了什么？

node.id: Archaeological Dig Site. Access prohibited for persons without permission.
node.to: 考古挖掘遗址。未经允许，严禁入内

node.id: Welcome to [LOCATION=TOWN_4], home of the jungle.
Another crumbled note: "I hid it in the northeastern corner of the court."
node.to: 另一个破碎的笔记："我把它藏了在球场的东北角"

node.id: There's lethal gas on the top.
node.to: 上面有致命的有毒气体

node.id: They must have gassed the place to try and kill whatever was inside.
node.to: 他们一定是试图用毒气消灭里面的东西

node.id: Tired of the same old chair? Super low prices for all types of seats!
node.to: 厌倦了你的旧椅子？这里有各类座椅超低价格

node.id: I would need to find some way to [GREEN]refine[WHITE] wood.
node.to: 我得想办法 [GREEN]加工[WHITE] 优质的木材

node.id: This archaeological site looks important. I should look around.
node.to: 这个考古遗址看起来很重要，我应该四处看看

node.id: I wonder if there are more audio logs such as this one laying around?
node.to: 我想知道是否有更多的音频日志

node.id: When venturing into [LOCATION=TOWN_10], be careful not to step out of your patrol vehicle. There are some strange plants around.
node.to: 当冒险进入 [LOCATION=TOWN_10] 地区，千万别走出巡逻车，周围有一些奇怪的植物

node.id: Founder's Day Special: 3 Nights, all inclusive. Only 58.99
node.to: 节日特别活动：3晚全包，仅需58.99元

node.id: This Sunday: A wondrous magic show for the whole family!
node.to: 这个星期天：为全家准备一场精彩的魔术表演

node.id: During our experiments with the structure, some mechanism triggered teleportation and temporal events.
node.to: 在我们的实验项目中，一些机制意外触发了传送和时间相关的事件

node.id: I need to have the[RED]Digital Wrist Watch[WHITE] equipped!
The Classified Cafe and Kitchen. Top Secret Menu [EMOJI=shushing face]
node.to: 绝密菜单 [EMOJI=shushing face] 各类咖啡和烹饪的美味佳肴

node.id: It looks like nature has done its damage. I hope that the mechanism still works. [EMOJI=crossed fingers]
node.to: 看来这里的植被生机盎然，希望这些机关还没被大自然破坏 [EMOJI=crossed fingers]

node.id: That did it! The passage is clear now. [EMOJI=victory hand]
node.to: 成功了！通道现在畅通了 [EMOJI=victory hand]

node.id: Archaeological Dig Site B\n Site supervisor: Dr. James\n Crown Archaeological Expedition
node.to: 考古发掘遗址 B \n 现场主管：詹姆斯博士 \n 皇冠考古探险队

node.id: Is this some kind of an idol? I wonder if the rest of it is underground? [EMOJI=moai]
node.to: 这是某种膜拜的雕像么，不知道剩下的部分是否在地下？[EMOJI=moai]

node.id: How did it end up here?! [EMOJI=face with raised eyebrow]
node.to: 它怎么会出现在这里？！[EMOJI=face with raised eyebrow]

node.id: I wonder what's inside that thing [EMOJI=thinking face]
node.to: 我想知道那东西里面是什么 [EMOJI=thinking face]
我应该激活那个 [GREEN]继电器 [WHITE]
从植物中收获的树叶等有机材料

node.id: Torn down and shredded bits of textile.
Bits and pieces of low quality wood found in nature and some furniture.
node.to: 在自然界和一些家具中发现劣质木材碎片

node.id: Hardy and strong organic material that is in better condition than scrap wood.
node.to: 坚硬而可靠的有机材料，比废木料状况更好

node.id: Wood that has been processed into beams and planks.
node.to: 木料加工成的优质板材

node.id: Bits and pieces of metal from worn down and broken objects.
node.to: 从磨损或破碎的金属物品中取出的金属碎片

node.id: A common form of metal used almost universally.
node.to: 一种普遍使用的金属材料

node.id: Highly refined alloy of iron and coal that is very strong.
node.to: 高度精炼的铁和煤的合金，非常坚固的材料

node.id: Advanced alloy of titanium and steel that is extremely resistant.
node.to: 钛和钢的高级合金，非常耐磨

node.id: A relatively common building material traditionally made of dried clay.
node.to: 一种相对普通的建筑材料，传统由粘土制成

node.id: A rare synthetic material with a wide range of uses.
node.to: 一种用途广泛的稀有合成材料

node.id: Damaged innards of electronic devices of all sorts.
node.to: 各种电子设备内部损坏的零部件

node.id: A rare material found in high tech equipment of the past.
node.to: 在过去的高科技设备中发现的稀有电子材料

node.id: Manufactured material that is solid and transparent.
node.to: 固体和透明的人造材料

node.id: Materials made by firing up nonmetallic minerals. Most often found in bathrooms.
node.to: 一种最常见于浴室的非金属矿物制成的材料

node.id: A common denominator for all sorts of solid or aggregates of minerals.
node.to: 各种固体或矿物聚聚集形成的物质

node.id: Leathery skin of an animal that can be used as a basis for clothing.
node.to: 动物的皮革，可用作衣物的基本材料

node.id: Processed form of a hide that is created via tanning.
node.to: 兽皮通过硫化鞣制而成的高级皮革材料

node.id: A flexible material made by interwoven fibers of natural or artificial origin.
node.to: 由天然或人造纤维交织而成的柔软材料

node.id: A synthetic or organic compound that can be molded into a variety of forms.
node.to: 一种可以模制成各种形式合成的或有机的化合物

node.id: A rare processed substance in a form of viscous liquid.
node.to: 一种以粘性液体稀有加工物质

node.id: Raw unprocessed bead of Mana brimming with power.
node.to: 充满力量的未加工神力珠

node.id: Shard of pure Mana brimming with power.
Peculiar round and smooth container brimming with power.
node.to: 充满力量的奇特圆滑球体

node.id: A flower found in tropical areas.
node.to: 一种生长于热带地区的神秘花朵

node.id: An edible mushroom found in temperate climates.
node.to: 一种生长于温带地区的可食用菌菇

node.id: An edible mushroom found in damp places.
node.to: 一种在潮湿的地方生长的可食用菌菇

node.id: A Rare and edible mushroom that grows in cold climates.
node.to: 一种生长在寒冷气候中的稀有可食用菌菇

node.id: A hard tissue found mostly inside animals.
node.to: 一种主要在动物体内发现的硬组织

node.id: An ordinary fish living everywhere. A true survivor.
node.to: 真正的幸存者就是这随处可见的普通鱼类

node.id: Hard to find and distracting fish of mystery.
node.to: 一种很难找到和分散注意力的神秘鱼
是一种珍贵美味的品种
神话中的那种巨型鲶鱼

node.id: Red and juicy fruit that grows in bushes.
node.to: 生长在灌木丛中的红色多汁的水果

node.id: An exotic plant substance found mostly in deserts.
node.to: 一种主要在沙漠中生长的植物

node.id: Organic matter from non-corrupted animals. Very rare in the current situation.
node.to: 一种罕见的来自未腐败动物的有机物

node.id: A sweet, edible fruit that grows in apple trees.
node.to: 一种生长在苹果树上甜的可食用的水果

node.id: A variety of small edible fruits that grow around in nature.
node.to: 一种生长在野外小小的可食的水果

node.id: A vegetable that grows its fruit under the ground and green leaves above ground.
node.to: 一种果实长在地下，地上是绿色叶子的蔬菜

node.id: A tall plant that produces edible kernels from its leafy stalk.
node.to: 长得比较高大，从多叶的茎中产生可食用的果实

node.id: A good source of protein. Laid by a variety of different species, such as birds and reptiles.
node.to: 一种高蛋白来源，由各种不同物种产下，如鸟类和爬行动物

node.id: A green plant that produces big edible leaves that are usable either raw or cooked.
node.to: 一种叶子可以生吃也可以煮熟吃的绿色植物

node.id: An underground vegetable that produces edible bulbs. Quite pungent if consumed raw.
node.to: 一种地下蔬菜他的鳞茎可以食用，生食时有强烈的刺激性

node.id: A root vegetable that produces edible tubers. Other parts of the plant are sadly toxic.
node.to: 块茎可食用，其他部分都是有毒的根茎蔬菜

node.id: Seeds of a certain type of grass that are usually boiled before ingestion. It can't be grown on the island, so it had great import value.
node.to: 最早生长于亚洲地区的谷物，稻穗通常在食用前要煮熟，由于它不能在岛上生长，所以它有很大的进口价值

node.id: A collection of different leaves, seeds, fruits and other plant substances added as flavoring to a food.
node.to: 可能来源于植物的叶子、种子、水果以及其他成分，通常用于食物添加调味剂

node.id: A grass that produces grains when cultivated. These grains can be ground into flour.
node.to: 这种谷物的麦穗可以磨成面粉

node.id: This is an automated recording sent from K23, the [EMOJI=crown] Crown Station.
node.to: 这是皇冠电台从K23发送的自动录音文件 [EMOJI=crown]

node.id: All working evacuation transports are outbound. Please keep calm, and wait for the maintenance.
node.to: 所有正在工作的疏散交通工具都已出发，请保持冷静，等待救援

node.id: To those of you thinking of building your private underground shelters, I say this: Is that really something that will help your Neighbors?
node.to: 对于那些想建造私人地下避难所的人，我想说：你愿意帮助你的邻居？

node.id: Or is it an act of pure selfishness? Something that only a [EMOJI=snake] Snake would do?
node.to: 还是纯粹的只是自救？只有自私恶毒的 [EMOJI=snake] 蛇才会做这样的事

node.id: Gathering points for the evacuation have been established. Please move to your designated area. Take only what you need.
node.to: 疏散集合点已经建立，请携带必须品前往指定的区域

node.id: Special message for the dear habitants of Capernaum.
node.to: 给亲爱的迦百农居民的特别信息

node.id: Your mighty walls will keep the monsters at bay. Sleep tightly. You are safe and loved.
node.to: 你有坚固的城墙可以阻挡怪物，睡个好觉，你是安全的

node.id: Avoid the coordinates E13 and U7 at all cost. Do not enter.
node.to: 不惜一切代价，千万别前往坐标E13和U7

node.id: In our darkest hour I implore you to stay vigilant. We WILL emerge from this stronger than ever.
node.to: 在我们最黑暗的时刻，我恳请你保持警惕。我们将从这场危机中脱颖而出，变得比以往任何时候都更强大

node.id: You should have already received your Amber Pill Container. Do not be afraid to use it. It will provide you permanent rest.
node.to: 你应该已经收到装有琥珀药丸的容器了吧。不要被他的说明吓到而惧怕使用它，它会让你获得长久的休息

node.id: A system of rationing has been put in place. We still have an abundance of food and supplies, but we need to conserve our strength for later.
node.to: 配给制度已经建立起来了，我们仍然有充足的食物和供给，但我们需要保存体力以备日后之用

node.id: The Island has fallen. Am I too to fall? Am I to leave this haven of my rest?
node.to: 这个岛已经陷落了，我是不是也将随之死亡？还是想办法离开这个地方？

node.id: Everyone will be provided safe transit as soon as possible.
node.to: 我们将尽快为每个人提供安全撤离工具

node.id: And as it were, a great mountain burning with fire was cast into the sea, and the third part of the ships were destroyed.
node.to: 就这样，一座被火烧红的大山倒入海里，船的三分之一也被毁坏了

node.id: It's been a week since the last working escape pod left. There is still one pod left, but we have uninstalled the fuel cells just in case. Do not use the pod.
node.to: 距离最后一个正常逃生舱离开已经有一个星期了。现在还有一个逃生舱，但我们已经卸载这个逃生舱的燃料电池以防万一，请不要使用逃生舱

node.id: There have been reports of hostile attacks in multiple areas of the Island. These are falsehoods perpetrated by antagonistic forces in our midst. Have no Fear.
node.to: 据报道，该岛多个地区发生了敌对袭击事件。这些都是我们中间混入的一些敌对势力制造的谎言，请不要恐慌

node.id: Please remain indoors, and refer to your Cobalt manual, page 27, for instructions.
node.to: 请待在室内，并仔细阅读深蓝指南第27页的说明

node.id: The Maintenance is now conducting a scheduled inspection of the Wall systems. You will need to comply with their orders.
node.to: 维修部门正在对隔离墙系统进行定期检查，你必须遵守服从他们的命令

node.id: Martial law has been declared to cover the western part of the island. We will have the situation under control in no time.
node.to: 该岛西部地区已宣布戒严，我们很快就能控制住局势

node.id: The curfew has been extended. Conduct your travel and business during daytime hours only. Be safe.
node.to: 宵禁时间延长了，请在白天的规定时间内进行出行和进行商务活动，务必注意安全

node.id: Security checkpoints have been established throughout the Island. Prepare to show your ID. All non-essential travel is prohibited.
node.to: 整个岛屿都设立了安全检查站，准备出示您的身份证ID，禁止所有非必要的出行

node.id: Our best and last line of defense, the Quadrumvirate, has been deployed to protect you, and those closest to you. Have no Fear.
node.to: 我们已经做好部署，最好的四人防御小组，已经派遣来保护你和你的亲人，请勿恐慌

node.id: If you encounter ANY unknown plant-life, please stay back, and report the location to the Liquidators.
node.to: 如果您遇到任何未知的植物，请迅速后退至安全位置，并向相关人员报告位置

node.id: The Quarantine is now declared to cover the whole island. Do not leave your house under any circumstance.
node.to: 现在宣布隔离措施将遍布整个岛屿，在任何情况下都不要离开你的房子

node.id: If you exhibit symptoms described in the Green Pamphlet, call for authorities, and stay in place.
node.to: 如果您出现绿色册子中描述的症状，请致电当局，并呆在原地

node.id: We are finally getting supply drops from the Motherland allies. Hang in tight. Have no Fear.
node.to: 我们终于从盟国那里得到了补给物资，坚持住就是胜利

node.id: Be kind to your Neighbour. We are all in this together. All misbehavior will be severely punished.
node.to: 善待你的邻居，存亡与共，一切不端的行为都将受到严厉的惩罚

node.id: The [EMOJI=crown] Crown has crushed the raiding parties. Do not steal from your [GREEN]Neighbour[WHITE].
node.to: [EMOJI=crown] 皇冠已经摧毁了袭击的敌人。不要偷盗 [GREEN]邻居[WHITE] 的物资

node.id: We've had reports of unmarked boats on southern shores. Please report any further sightings straight to the [EMOJI=crown] Crown.
node.to: 我们收到了关于南部海岸有无标记船只的报告，如有任何进一步的目击事件，请直接向 [EMOJI=crown] 皇冠报告

node.id: We should not lead [EMOJI=snake] Snakes into our Garden. Do not disclose the location of our beloved Island to any outsider.
node.to: 我们不应该把 [EMOJI=snake] 毒蛇引入我们的花园，不要向任何外人透露我们心爱的岛屿的位置，引狼入室很危险

node.id: This is a friendly reminder. Know this. Borealis awaits everyone who crosses the [EMOJI=crown] Crown.
node.to: 友情提示：要知道北极光在等待着每一个穿越 [EMOJI=crown] 皇冠的人

node.id: Our community is stronger and more prosperous than ever. There is no room for [EMOJI=snake] Snakes here.
node.to: 我们的社区比以往任何时候都更加强大和繁荣，这里没有 [EMOJI=snake] 毒蛇的容身之所

node.id: In our time of Need and Want, there is no place for selfish actions.
node.to: 在这个物资匮乏的年代，自私行为没有任何容身之地

node.id: Repeat. The Pale Protocol is in motion. Refer to your Cobalt Manual, and await further instructions from the [EMOJI=crown] Crown.
node.to: 重复：协议正在执行中！请参阅您的手册，等待皇冠 [EMOJI=crown] 的进一步指示

node.id: All excavation projects are hereby prohibited. Continuing excavations is considered a hostile act against the [EMOJI=crown] Crown.
node.to: 禁止一切挖掘工程！继续挖掘被认定是对 [EMOJI=crown] 皇冠的敌对行为

node.id: I think it is clear that the Incidents are not isolated anymore. This cannot be contained, but we can still fight it.
node.to: 我认为很明显，这些事件不再是孤立的。这是无法遏制的，但我们仍然可以与之斗争

node.id: Everyone who has chosen to stay on our island of hope is welcome to seek shelter at the [EMOJI=crown] Undercrown.
node.to: 欢迎所有选择留在我们希望之岛的人到 [EMOJI=crown] 皇冠地下寻求庇护

node.id: Our scientists at Fort Knowledge are working relentlessly to fully understand the phenomena around Mana. Do not disturb their work.
node.to: 我们的科学家们正在不懈地努力，以充分了解有关神力的现象，请不要打扰他们的工作

node.id: The Mining Company has now excavated an estimated 5% of the Mana reserves. We already have more than enough for our needs. We should not be greedy.
node.to: 矿业公司目前已挖掘出大约5%的神力储量，对于我们的需求来说已经绰绰有余，我们不应该再贪婪了

node.id: Our society is built on the four discovered Mana Effects. When the rest of the world entered the atomic age, we were already a million steps ahead.
node.to: 我们的社会是建立在四个已发现的神力效应之上的。当世界其他地区进入原子时代时，我们已经领先了一百万步

node.id: The First Mana Effect: the Heat. With the right catalyst, Mana produces heat without losing its mass.
node.to: 第一个神力效果：热量供应。如果有合适的催化剂，神力可以在不损失能量的情况下产生热量

node.id: This may not sound like much, but this powers our industry and keeps us warm. An infinite source of energy.
node.to: 这听起来可能很一般，但这为我们的行业提供了动力，让我们保持温暖，而且是无限的能量来源

node.id: The gates of [EMOJI=crown] Undercrown are now open. Welcome, my children.
node.to: 欢迎，我的子民们，[EMOJI=crown]皇冠地下的大门现在已经打开了

node.id: The Second Mana Effect: Cornucopia. In layman's terms, Mana can be used to transform any substance into any other substance.
node.to: 第二个神力效应：聚宝盆。用外行的话来说，神力可以用来将任何物质转化成任何其他物质

node.id: But forget the ancient island legends, the effect requires fine-tuned digital electronics of the modern age. The Fabricators.
node.to: 但别忘了岛屿上流传的古老传说，这种效应需要现代化的数字电子设备 - 制造机器 - 来实现

node.id: The Third Mana Effect: The Temporal Shift. When mana is heated to high temperatures, nearby observers experience sudden shifts in time.
node.to: 第三种神力效应：时间偏移。当神力被加热到高温时，附近的物体会经历时间的突变

node.id: All experimentation on this effect is prohibited. Let's not meddle with the structures of time.
node.to: 禁止对此效应进行任何实验，我们尽量不要干预时间的结构

node.id: Regarding the Fourth Mana Effect. As you know, we cannot disclose the fourth effect, but we should not ignore and forget it.
node.to: 关于第四个神力效应。正如你所知，我们不能透露第四种效应的影响力，但我们不应该忽视和忘记它的存在

node.id: You should keep your distance to Mana and only allow trained professionals to handle it.
node.to: 你应该和神力保持距离，让训练有素的专业人士来处理

node.id: Mana has brought us unimaginable prosperity. But should we share this with the rest of the world? I say: not yet.
node.to: 神力给我们带来了无与伦比的繁荣。但是我们应该和世界其他地方分享吗？我会说：不

node.id: The gates of [EMOJI=crown] Undercrown are now sealed. May you find solace inside our unyielding fortress.
node.to: [EMOJI=crown] 皇冠地下的大门已经被封锁了，愿你们在我们的坚不可摧的王宫里找到一丝慰藉

node.id: With my inevitable leave of absence looming in, I hope you understand why I had to do what I've done.
node.to: 我无可避免的将要离开了，我希望你们能理解我的所作所为

node.id: I know not many will believe my story, but it is the unlikely truth. But none of it matters soon. The end is nigh.
node.to: 我知道没有多少人会相信我的故事，我只是在陈述事情的真相，不过无关紧要，一切都快结束了

node.id: There have been rumors about my well-being, and it is true I haven't shown myself in public for a long time. But rest assured I am well and capable.
node.to: 有传言说我的健康出了问题，确实我很久没有在公众面前露面了。但请放心，我很好

node.id: Spent years and years at his underground shelter. Now surfaced and seeks a way out of this place.
node.to: 在地下庇护所待了很多年后，现在想办法离开庇护所，并设法逃离这里的幸存者

node.id: It all started when the Great Blue Tear dropped from the Sky.
node.to: 一切始于一颗巨大的蓝色泪珠划破天际

node.id: With great thunder it hit Mother Earth, and ripped her open.
node.to: 伴随着巨大的冲击声，撕裂了大地

node.id: This is how Mana came to us. The bittersweet gift from the Sky.
node.to: 神力，这让我们喜乐参半的天赐之礼，来到了我们身边

node.id: Maybe Mana did come from outer space within a meteorite or something?
node.to: 也许神力只是来自于外太空的陨石，或者还有其他不可预知的东西？

node.id: The bringer of great knowledge, the One-Armed King, descended to us from the Skies.
node.to: 他带来了伟大的知识，我们愿尊之为独臂国王

node.id: We welcomed the king to our tribe. We greeted him as one of our own.
node.to: 他就像是我们自己的族人一样受到大家欢迎

node.id: Did they meet an angel or an alien, or is that story just greatly exaggerated?
node.to: 他们是遇到了天使还是外星人，或者只是这个故事被夸大了？

node.id: The One-Armed King taught us about Mana. We learned to make many great things.
node.to: 独臂国王教会了我们神力的知识，我们运用神力做很多伟大的事情

node.id: But only the king knew sorcery without Mana. Why would he not teach us this?
node.to: 但只有国王知道不受神力侵蚀的秘密，他为什么不教我们这个呢？

node.id: Considering what our scientists and engineers have built from Mana, maybe the ancient folks were onto something.
node.to: 鉴于我们的科学家和工程师们用神力创造的奇迹，也许古人真的发现了什么

node.id: For a thousand years, the tribe flourished.
node.to: 数千年来，部落蓬勃发展，欣欣向荣

node.id: We built great cities, and we praised the One-Armed King.
node.to: 我们建造了伟大的城市，我们拥戴独臂国王

node.id: But we should not have done this.

node.to: 随之而来是可怕的瘟疫

node.id: It has taken many of us, but we are fighting it.
node.to: 很多人都失去了生命，但我们没有放弃抗争

node.id: But how come the One-Armed King was not affected?
node.to: 为什么独臂国王不会受到瘟疫影响？

node.id: Did the king bring this upon us?
node.to: 难道是他带来了这一切？

node.id: They don't seem very appreciative of the magical sky being that taught them magic.
node.to: 他们似乎开始怀疑这来自天空的神力了

node.id: The wise elders confronted the One-Armed King.
node.to: 睿智的长老们准备与国王对峙

node.id: 'You brought this on us.', said the elders, 'You are the Pestilence.'
node.to: 长老们指着国王说：是你，一定是你带来了瘟疫，你才是罪魁祸首

node.id: The One-Armed King could not convince the wise elders with his lies and deceit.
node.to: 睿智的长老们没有被独臂国王的谎言蒙蔽

node.id: Well that sounds like a fair trial.
node.to: 听起来这是个公平的审判

node.id: The brave warriors grabbed the One-Armed King while he was sleeping.
node.to: 勇敢的战士们趁着国王睡着抓住了他

node.id: The king was thrown into the Deepest Pit on the island. We all watched.
node.to: 将他丢进了岛上的深渊里。我们都期待着…

node.id: Surely the Pestilence would end now?
But when we returned to our village, the king was already waiting for us there.
node.to: 但是当我们回到部落，发现独臂国王已经在那里等着我们了

node.id: 'I forgive you.', said the Immortal King.
node.to: 他却说：“我饶恕你们的行为”

node.id: But we didn't believe his lies and deceit. He is a Snake.
node.to: 我们不再相信他毒蛇一般的谎言

node.id: The wise elders now knew what was to be done.
node.to: 睿智的长老们已经想到该怎么办了

node.id: The guy tried to offer an olive branch after being thrown in a pit.
node.to: 这家伙被丢进了深渊，居然还试图伸出橄榄枝

node.id: The great pyramid tomb was built.
node.to: 终于，巨大的金字塔坟墓落成了

node.id: With heavy hearts we buried the Immortal King deep inside the tomb.
node.to: 我们怀着沉重的心情把不朽的国王深深地埋进了坟墓里

node.id: Buried alive so he cannot die.
node.to: 既然杀不死国王，我们就活埋他！

node.id: On silent nights, we can still hear the screams of the Immortal King echoing from the tomb.
node.to: 凄厉的惨叫回荡在寂静的夜空

node.id: There is no escape for the king.
But there was still something more we needed to do.
That's cruel and all, but that tomb must contain some valuable treasures. I should enter that pyramid tomb.
node.to: 太残忍了！但那座坟墓里肯定有一些珍贵的宝藏，我应该进入金字塔墓穴去看看

node.id: 'We should not trust any of the king's descendants.', said the elders.
node.to: 长老们说：不能相信国王的后代

node.id: All women and children descendants were banished off the island into the mercy of the sea.
node.to: 于是，妇孺被驱逐出岛，流放大海

node.id: All male descendants of the king were buried alive in isolated tombs.
node.to: 子嗣被分别活埋在各地的墓地里

node.id: Tears were shed, but we need to be sure we do not repeat our mistakes.
node.to: 纵有不忍，但一切只是为了避免了重蹈覆辙

node.id: How did that work out for you, island folks?
We all do what we must just to survive... Just to exist...
node.to: 为了活下去，我们必须做点什么…只是为了活下去…

node.id: When our society started to collapse, I was prepared.
node.to: 在世界开始沦陷前，我做好了准备

node.id: My underground shelter was filled with food and supplies.
node.to: 我在地下庇护所囤积了大量的食品和物资

node.id: But that was years ago. Nothing's left now.
node.to: 但那是几年前的事了，现在什么都消耗殆尽了

node.id: I've no idea what awaits me at the surface, but I can't stay here.
node.to: 我不知道地面上等着我的是什么，但我不能再继续呆下去了

node.id: All I know is that there's supposed to be an evacuation site to the |#22ff22|east|#ffffff|.
node.to: 我只知道在 |#22ff22|东边|#ffffff| 应该有一个疏散点

node.id: I need to get there. I need to |#ff2222|escape|#ffffff| this wretched island.
node.to: 我要前往那里，我要 |#ff2222|逃离|#ffffff| 这个该死的岛屿

node.id: This is Judith Abigail Susan James, the [EMOJI=crown] Crown Archaeological Expedition.
node.to: 我是 [EMOJI=crown] 皇冠考古队的朱迪思·艾比盖尔·苏珊·詹姆斯

node.id: Testing. Testing. This is Judith Abigail Susan James, the [EMOJI=crown] Crown Archaeological Expedition.
node.to: 测试…测试…我是 [EMOJI=crown] 皇冠考古队的朱迪思·艾比盖尔·苏珊·詹姆斯

node.id: We're starting out our investigation at the canyon.
node.to: 我们正在愚人峡谷开展调查

node.id: The main artefact is large, pyramid shaped, and appears to have some sort of an entrance at the top.
node.to: 主要的文物体积很大，呈金字塔形状，顶部似乎有一个入口

node.id: We'll start closer examination tomorrow after a good night's sleep. Very exciting.
node.to: 真是激动人心，先睡个好觉，我们明天就开始细致的发掘

node.id: These stone tablets seem to tell some ancient legend, but it's as if the markings have been somehow scratched off.
node.to: 这些石碑似乎讲述了一些古老的传说，可惜上面的印记不知道怎么回事被划掉了

node.id: Our electronics equipment keeps malfunctioning near this site.
node.to: 我们的电子设备在这附近一直出故障

node.id: Oh, and, there's an eerie glow around the stone ring at night. No apparent source for the light, yet it glows.
node.to: 而且晚上这一圈石碑发出了一种诡异的光芒。我们没有发现明显的光源，但它确实会发光

node.id: We need to come back to this later, I'm sure there's a way to restore these and read the legends.
node.to: 我们稍后会再次讨论这个问题，我相信肯定有办法还原这些石碑记载的传说

node.id: Notes on the pyramid. Last night, I swear we heard a cry for help inside the pyramid. Very creepy.
node.to: 关于金字塔的笔记：昨晚，我发誓我们听到了金字塔墓里的呼救声，一种毛骨悚然的恐怖感油然而生

node.id: The team got so anxious that we decided to play it safe and fill the structure with cyanide gas before attempting entry.
node.to: 大家为此感到非常焦虑。为了安全起见，我们最后决定将有毒氰化物气体注入的金字塔墓

node.id: The voices seem to have stopped now, so it was probably just some wildlife.
node.to: 声音似乎停止了，或许里面只是躲了一只野猫

node.id: Supplemental. We've waited for two days but the gas is not evaporating for some reason.
node.to: 补充一下，我们等了两天，但不知出于何种原因，气体居然没有蒸发

node.id: It's weird, but it's not the weirdest thing we've encountered on the island.
node.to: 这很奇怪，但这不是我们在岛上遇到的最奇怪的事情

node.id: We'll need to get the [GREEN]Gas Masks[WHITE] from our [ORANGE]Jungle Camp[WHITE] if we are to enter.
node.to: 如果我们要进入金字塔墓，就不得不去 [ORANGE]丛林里的营地[WHITE] 获得 [GREEN]毒气面罩[WHITE]

node.id: Apparently [ORANGE]The Beachhead Station[WHITE] took them during their last resupply mission.
node.to: 很显然，[ORANGE]滩头站[WHITE] 在他们最后一次补给任务中带走了它们

node.id: They also reported some 'strange phenomenon' deeper in the jungle. Intriguing.
node.to: 他们还报告了丛林深处的一些耐人寻味的“奇怪现象”

node.id: We better head that way. We'll just take one detour to see the new artefact discovered at [ORANGE]The Site B[WHITE].
node.to: 我们最好往那边走，我们只需绕道一圈，就可以在 [ORANGE]发掘遗址B[WHITE] 看到新发掘的文物

node.id: The architecture and items found at site B definitely match the ones found at the Canyon.
node.to: 在发掘遗址B发现的建筑遗址和文物与愚人峡谷发现的完全吻合

node.id: One of the artefacts found is a pouch full of small glowing beads. These are exactly like the one my mother has in her necklace.
node.to: 其中一件被发现的文物是一个装满发光小珠子的袋子，这些小珠子和我妈妈项链上的简直一模一样

node.id: So... I guess she was right.
A team of selected people will follow me deeper into the overgrown jungle.
node.to: 一队经过严格挑选的队员会跟着我深入到这个长满竹子、椰树、榕树等大量植被的茂密丛林中

node.id: Not sure if we should be worried, but we have lost all contact with the [ORANGE]Beachhead Station[WHITE].
node.to: 不知道是否应该有所担忧，我们已经失去了与 [ORANGE]滩头站[WHITE] 的所有联系

node.id: We have arrived at the [ORANGE]Temple Pass[WHITE].
node.to: 我们已经到了 [ORANGE]神殿通道[WHITE]

node.id: The architecture is very intriguing. It looks like there's even some rudimentary technology inside!
node.to: 这个建筑真是迷人，看起来甚至有一些从未见过的工艺！

node.id: However, there's no clear way to pass through, but we're adamant we'll find a solution soon enough.
node.to: 然而，我们暂时还没有打开机关的办法，但我们坚信我们会很快找到解决方案

node.id: Supplemental. We noticed that there has been some trouble with our timekeeping.
node.to: 补充一下，我们注意到我们的计时出现了一些问题

node.id: It is almost like the flow of time is being affected by some anomaly. Maybe it's just exhaustion on our part.
node.to: 就像时间的流动受到了某种异常现象的影响，或许这只是我们太累了，产生了错觉

node.id: The Beachhead outpost looks like it has been hastily abandoned. Where could they have gone?
node.to: 滩头站看起来像是匆忙间被放弃的，他们到底去了哪里？

node.id: Most of the items have just been left at their places. No sign of the [GREEN]Gas Masks[WHITE] though.
node.to: 大部分物资都留在了原处，但我们没有发现 [GREEN]毒气面罩[WHITE] 的迹象

node.id: Supplemental. I found William's journal. This is deeply disturbing. Why would they do this?
node.to: 我找到了威廉的日记，这令人深感不安，他们为什么要这么做

node.id: Going north and following the river should take us past the [ORANGE]Temple Ground[WHITE] and to their new camp.
node.to: 顺着河流往北走，经过 [ORANGE]神殿地堡[WHITE]，我们应该能到达他们的新营地

node.id: Campsite looks empty and neglected. No [GREEN]Gas Masks[WHITE]. Really frustrating.
node.to: 营地看上去空无一人，令人沮丧的是依然没有 [GREEN]毒气面罩[WHITE] 的踪迹

node.id: It Looks like the station crew have made camp and then continued through the [ORANGE]Rocky Mountain Path[WHITE]. We'll follow them.
node.to: 看来滩头站的工作人员已经扎营，然后继续沿着 [ORANGE]火山山路[WHITE] 前进了，我们得继续跟着他们

node.id: I should also mention I've felt some unusual mental discomfort during our trek through the wilderness.
node.to: 不得不提的是我们在穿越丛林荒野的跋涉中，精神上感到非常不适

node.id: Am I starting to go crazy?
I am alone, and badly wounded.
node.to: 就剩我孤身一人了，我真的伤得很重

node.id: I'm hoping Crown received my message and help is on the way.
node.to: 我希望皇冠已经收到了我的求援信号在来的路上了

node.id: I fear all my colleagues are dead. We shouldn't have come here.
node.to: 我担心其他同事是不是都死了，我们不该来这里的

node.id: Supplemental. Still alone and waiting. If anyone finds this recording, please listen carefully.
node.to: 我仍然在独自等待，如果有人发现这段录音，请仔细听下去

node.id: I understand it all now. We set it free. It's what we did at the pyramid.
node.to: 我终于明白了，是我们解开了封印，正是我们之前在金字塔墓地的所作所为，让他逃了出来

node.id: Will it happen to me too when I die?
node.to: 不知道我死后，这种现象会不会也发生在我身上？

node.id: As I have foreseen, the world is about to end in [RED]-999[WHITE] days.
node.to: 正如我所料，世界将在 [RED]-999[WHITE] 天内结束

node.id: But thanks to our hardworking Volunteers, we are preserving the world as we know it.
node.to: 但多亏了我们辛勤工作的志愿者，我们正在保护我们所知道的世界

node.id: Sample by sample, we are filling the archives with remnants of our time.
node.to: 一个样本接一个样本，我们正在存储归档我们时代的痕迹

node.id: The task is colossal, but we will achieve it.
node.to: 这项任务是艰巨的，但我们会完成的

node.id: The invention of agriculture kickstarted civilisation.
node.to: 农业开创了文明的起点

node.id: By harvesting the land, we were able to thrive.
node.to: 通过收割田地的庄稼，我们得以茁壮成长

node.id: The samples in this collection are all edible.
node.to: 这批样品都是可以食用的

node.id: But do not eat. Deposit instead.
As our numbers rapidly multiplied, so did our needs beyond just nourishing ourselves.
node.to: 因为除了养活自己，随着人口迅速膨胀，我们的需求也会迅速增加

node.id: We scoured this earth of materials to build both our homes and massive cities.
node.to: 我们在这片土地上搜寻材料，建造我们的家园和城市

node.id: The samples in this collection are all inedible.
node.to: 这一批样品都是不能食用的

node.id: By refining the hardiest of materials we were able to touch the sky itself.
node.to: 通过提炼最坚硬的材料，我们能够飞向天空

node.id: Towers of steel and glass, larger by themselves than some cities of old.
node.to: 钢塔和玻璃塔，甚至比一些古老的城市还要高大

node.id: When mankind was still young, we did not differentiate ourselves from nature.
node.to: 当人类还在原始阶段的时候，我们并没有把自己与自然区分开来

node.id: We lived a simple, blissful life, enjoying the bounties of the earth.
node.to: 我们过着简朴幸福的生活，享受着大自然的馈赠与恩赐

node.id: We slowly evolved and started to understand we were something more than just a part of nature.
node.to: 随着人类慢慢进化，开始明白我们不仅仅是大自然的一部分

node.id: By creating the first crude tools and by donning clothes, we set ourselves apart.
node.to: 通过创造最原始的工具和穿上衣服，我们使自己与众不同

node.id: Unlike the alchemists of old, we actually are able to transmutate matter into exotic materials.
node.to: 不像古代的炼金术士，我们实际上能够把自然界的物质转化成各种奇异的材料

node.id: We have bent nature to our will and in the process have created unimaginable prosperity.
node.to: 我们逐步让大自然的本性屈从于我们的意志，并在这个过程中创造了难以想象的繁荣

node.id: Thank you to all our volunteers.
node.to: 感谢我们所有的志愿者

node.id: The Afterparty will be held at Level 2.
node.to: 庆祝完工的派对将在二层举行

node.id: There will be cocktail snacks and beverages, and a live band playing my favorite song.
node.to: 有各种小吃和饮料，还有现场乐队演奏我最喜欢的歌曲

node.id: The Ark Level 2 is now accessible. Welcome.
node.to: 欢迎光临，现在可以进入方舟二层

node.id: I thought I was dead. [EMOJI=hushed face]
This does raise some hard questions about existence...
node.to: 这确实引发了一些关于活着…的难题

node.id: I guess it is just a vicious cycle.
node.to: 我想这只是一个恶性循环

node.id: It feels good to be alive again.
Immortality's out of bounds, it's a one-round ride... or so I thought.
node.to: 永生是不可能的，我想或许这不过是一个轮回…

node.id: A true survivor doesn't die even if he's killed!
node.to: 一个即便被杀了也不会真正死去的幸存者

node.id: My existence will not be vanquished so easily!
node.to: 我就那个无法击败的存在！

node.id: I have reached my golden deathiversary...
node.to: 喜提50次死亡，就像金婚50周年一样值得纪念

node.id: Another timely escape from the prickly fingers of death!
node.to: 又一次从死亡的魔爪中逃脱

node.id: Is 100 deaths really something to celebrate?

这看起来很有价值 [EMOJI=thinking face]
天然糖果？ [EMOJI=face with raised eyebrow]

node.id: Nothing! It seems there's no more fish here. [EMOJI=thinking face]
node.to: 什么都没有，看来这里没有鱼了 [EMOJI=thinking face]

node.id: Nothing! Fish don't seem to bite here. Better move on.

node.id: Nothing! Well, there's plenty of fish in the sea, but just not in this spot. [EMOJI=face with rolling eyes]
node.to: 什么都没有，嗯，水里有很多鱼，但这个地方没有 [EMOJI=face with rolling eyes]

node.id: Fish don't seem to be biting anymore. I should switch places.

node.id: This spot is devoid of fish. I should probably find another place.

I just thought of something. I should return to the [ORANGE]campfire[WHITE].

Today is the first day of the rest of my life!

node.id: When I put my mind to it I can overcome anything!

The day when I finally get out of this island is ever closer.

我发现了一些隐藏的东西！

The ground must be shaped with a hoe before planting seeds.

Are you trying to avoid me?

node.id: The old monsters who attacked the base are now dead. However, the structure is still active and it's effects are affecting the world around it.

node.id: The air is feeling very hot and it's going to get even worse further south. Maybe there's something at the Train Station that could help your chance of survival.
node.to: 空气里充满了燥热的气息，继续往南情况会变得更糟。也许在火车站有什么东西可以帮助你抵抗过度的炎热
