星期一：酪乳，星期二：炼乳

node.id: Focus on week 32: Quantum Applications of milk
Milk experiments are sadly at a standstill until we receive more material from the military.
node.to: 令人遗憾的是，在我们从军方获得更多材料之前，牛奶实验一直处于停滞状态

node.id: They should have been here a few days ago, so something might have happened to them.
node.to: 他们几天前就该来了，所以他们可能出了什么事

node.id: REDACTED can affect flow of REDACTED and could theoretically be used as REDACTED
node.to: REDACTED可以影响REDACTED的效果，理论上可以用于REDACTED

node.id: Welcome to Arcadia, the last, best hope for humanity.
node.to: 欢迎来到阿卡迪亚，人类最后的希望

node.id: How did I get up here? [EMOJI=worried face]
I hope I'm not going to be next.. [EMOJI=grimacing face]
node.to: 我希望我不是下一个… [EMOJI=grimacing face]

node.id: Day 5: We managed to erect some defenses around the camp.
node.to: 第5天：我们设法在营地周围建立了一些防御工事

node.id: Day 33: Morale is dropping fast. People are fed up with a fish based diet.
node.to: 第33天：人们已经厌倦了天天吃鱼，士气正在迅速下降

node.id: This is as far as we were able to get. The landscape is turning increasingly hostile as we continue further north.
node.to: 我们只能走到这里了，如果继续往北走，地势会越来越险恶

node.id: We have camped up to weigh our options, as there probably isn't a safe place left on the island.
node.to: 我们对露营地做了权衡，因为岛上可能已经没有安全的地方了

node.id: The fuel cell signal is somewhere nearby!
node.to: 燃料电池信号就在附近！

node.id: It is coming from under the water!
It seems that workers at the dam lived at the [LOCATION=FROST_HORN_TOWN_2]. Perhaps the key is with them.
node.to: 大坝的工人住在 [LOCATION=FROST_HORN_TOWN_2]，也许钥匙在那边

node.id: The [LOCATION=FROST_HORN_TOWN_2] should be North of my position.
We have been trying to get vital cargo to the [LOCATION=FROST_HORN_ARCTIC_BASE] but our vehicles keep getting stuck in the mud.
node.to: 我们尝试将重要货物带到 [LOCATION=FROST_HORN_ARCTIC_BASE]，但是我们的车陷在了泥里

node.id: What could the cargo be? Something to stop this apocalypse we are living in?
node.to: 重要货物是什么？难道是结束我们所在的这个世界末日的东西？

node.id: So let me get this straight: We have no food, but 5 years worth of Snort Cola? Who planned this? Steve?
node.to: 所以让我直截了当地说：我们没有食物，但是有5年的Snort可乐？这是谁安排的？史提夫？

node.id: The [ORANGE]Undercrown[WHITE] east entrance is now open.
node.to: [ORANGE]皇冠地下[WHITE] 的东门现在已经开放

node.id: Hold down [BUTTON=ROTATE_CAMERA] and drag to control the camera.
node.to: 按住并拖动 [BUTTON=ROTATE_CAMERA] 来控制视角

node.id: Now I'll just check everything is operational.
node.to: 现在我检查一下一切是否正常

node.id: I need to find my way to the [EMOJI=crown] Crown Station.
node.to: 我需要找到去 [EMOJI=crown] 皇冠站的路

node.id: Spooky. The food must be out of this world!
node.to: 这就是世界上最好的食物！

node.id: "A word of warning. Be wary of extremely hot local temperatures. Military activity in the area is also at heightened state. Southern parts inaccessible."
node.to: "警告：警惕当地酷热的气温，该地区的军事活动已处于戒备加强状态，南部地区已经无法进入"

node.id: "Some people requested more salad recipes in the food menu. The Chef added Steakhouse Salad as a compromise."
node.to: "有些人要求在食物菜单上增加沙拉食谱，所以厨师添加了牛排沙拉作为折衷方案"

node.id: "ATC Report: Severe atmospheric disturbances detected. All planes grounded until further notice."
node.to: "检测报告：检测到严重的气流干扰，所有飞机停飞，直到另行通知"

node.id: "The Fabricator we sent to [LOCATION=POLARIS_FACILITY] is having some data corruption issues. Clearly needs simpler instructions."
node.to: "送到 [LOCATION=POLARIS_FACILITY] 的机器存在一些数据损坏问题，显然需要更简单的说明"

node.id: "The patient has both frostbites and thermal burns."
"All high security traffic must use the [ORANGE]Crown Station Access Elevators[WHITE] only."
node.to: "进入 [ORANGE]皇冠站出入口电梯[WHITE] 必须要高度注意安全"

node.id: It looks like the access elevator should be nearby.
node.to: 看起来电梯入口应该在附近

node.id: [EMOJI=up arrow] Undercrown Shelters\n[EMOJI=building construction] Loading Areas\n[EMOJI=crown] Crown Station Access
node.to: [EMOJI=up arrow] 皇冠地下庇护所 \n[EMOJI=building construction]装货区 \n[EMOJI=crown] 皇冠站通道

node.id: This requires a lot of materials. But there's no hurry I guess.
node.to: 这需要大量的材料，但我想不必着急

node.id: That's a lot of eggs. But I guess I can deposit the ones I don't need here.
node.to: 那有很多蛋，但是我想我可以把我不需要的存到这里

node.id: The old monsters who attacked the base are now dead. However, the rift is still active and its effects are affecting the world around it.
node.to: 攻击基地的老怪物已经死了，然而裂缝依然活跃着，而且它的影响正在波及周围的世界
检查 [ORANGE]逃生舱[WHITE] 的燃料

node.id: There is a dropped notebook page on ground: One of the guests is reportedly acting suspiciously. Keeps carrying valuable looking items. Maybe contraband. \n[GREEN]Motel's Office[WHITE] should have the guest and room info.
node.to: 地上掉了一页笔记：据报告其中一位客人的行为可疑，随身携带着贵重物品，也许是违禁品 \n[GREEN]汽车旅馆的办公室[WHITE] 应该有客人和房间的信息

node.id: The final fuel cell resides in the artificial lake created by the dam. You need to drain it.
node.to: 最后一个燃料电池位于发电站大坝的水库中，你需要把水排干

node.id: A thundering boom gives way to quiet sounds of dripping. The Artificial lake has been emptied.
node.to: 雷鸣般的隆隆声过后，水库的水已排干了

node.id: There is a strange doorway in the middle of the military base. What could be inside?
node.to: 在军事基地的中间有一个奇怪的门，里面会是什么?

node.id: The road leading deeper into the structure is ruined. Find an alternate route.
node.to: 通往建筑物更深处的道路被毁了，需要找到另一条路线

node.id: The elevator ahead should take you up to the Crown Station.
node.to: 前面的电梯会把你送到皇冠站
水电站大坝控制室钥匙

node.id: The rise of civilization was sparked by the invention of agriculture.
node.to: 农业开创了文明的起点
不要吃掉它， 把它存起来

node.id: We scoured the earth of materials. We built homes. Towns.
node.to: 我们在这片土地上搜寻材料，建造我们的家园和城市

node.id: The samples in this collection are building blocks of our civilization.
node.to: 这些样品是我们文明的基石

node.id: Deposit them, so the next generation has a chance.
node.to: 把它们存起来，这样下一代就有机会了

node.id: The samples in this collection will ensure our safety in the coming age.
node.to: 收集样品将确保我们未来的安全

node.id: Deposit them for the continued survival of mankind.
node.to: 为了人类的存续而存储它们

node.id: We lived a simple and blissful life, enjoying the bounties of the earth.
node.to: 我们过着简朴幸福的生活，享受着大自然的馈赠与恩赐

node.id: The samples in this collection are all found in nature.
node.to: 这些收集的样品都是在自然界中发现的

node.id: Gather and deposit them here with care and respect.
node.to: 小心地把它们收集起来并存放在这里

node.id: We slowly evolved. We started to understand that we were something more than just a part of nature.
node.to: 随着人类慢慢进化，开始明白我们不仅仅是大自然的一部分

node.id: By creating the first primitive tools and clothes, we set ourselves apart.
node.to: 通过创造最原始的工具和穿上衣服，我们使自己与众不同

node.id: The samples in this collection are the ingredients of the dawn of humanity.
node.to: 这些收集的样本是人类曙光

node.id: Now kindly deposit the materials for the future of mankind.
node.to: 现在请为人类的未来储存材料

node.id: The samples in this collection are the stepping stones on the path to beyond.
node.to: 本系列中的样本是通往超越之路的踏脚石

node.id: Lay down the samples so we can continue from where we left off.
node.to: 把样品放好，这样我们就可以从停下来的地方继续了

node.id: The Ark is almost complete. Please carry on the good work.
node.to: 方舟差不多完工了，请继续做好这项工作

node.id: I want to remind all our Volunteers that there will be an afterparty.
node.to: 我想提醒我们所有的志愿者，派对马上开始

node.id: It will be held at Level 2 when the Ark is complete.
node.to: 当方舟完成后，它将在第二层举行.

node.id: Locked! I need to find out how to open this door. Maybe there are clues nearby?
node.to: 锁住了！我需要知道如何打开这扇门，也许附近有什么线索?

node.id: Finally here! Now to find that key!
node.to: 终于到了！现在去找到那把钥匙!

node.id: This does not look very accessible either. [EMOJI=neutral face]
node.to: 这看起来无法进入 [EMOJI=neutral face]

node.id: There's another [GREEN]doorway[WHITE] in the room. It looks like I have to find [GREEN]a detour[WHITE]. [EMOJI=grimacing face]
node.to: 房间里还有另外 [GREEN]一扇门[WHITE] ，看来我得从 [GREEN]另外一条路[WHITE] 绕过去 [EMOJI=grimacing face]

node.id: The Ark is now [NUMBER] percent complete.
node.to: 方舟现在已经完成百分之[NUMBER]

node.id: Upgrade Sleeping Bag to sleep longer.
node.to: 升级睡袋可以延长睡眠时间

node.id: Not enough [GREEN]XP[WHITE] (Experience Points). Spending points would lower your [GREEN]Experience Level[WHITE], which is not allowed.
node.to: [GREEN]经验值[WHITE]不足，继续消耗经验值，否则会降低[GREEN]等级[WHITE]，禁止如此操作

node.id: Maximum number of hours to sleep [AMOUNT]

Unfortunately The Island Military is not interested in your Helmet designs. While quite effective in harsh weather, it does not provide enough protection against other forces. Our testers did like the classic look of the helmet very much though.
node.to: 不幸的是，岛上军方对你的头盔设计不感兴趣。虽然在恶劣天气下非常有效，但它不能提供足够的保护来抵御其他伤害。不过，我们的测试人员确实非常喜欢头盔的经典外观

node.id: The sample helmet is held at the Military Road Checkpoint and you can get it back from there.
node.to: 沙漠头盔的样品放在军用公路的检查站，你可以从那里取回

node.id: The structure has become increasingly active for as yet unknown reasons. It is affecting the flow time around it and is also causing some local spatial anomalies.
node.to: 由于某些未知的原因，结构变得越来越不稳定。它影响了周围时间的流动，也造成了一些局部空间异常

node.id: The Digital Watch we invented mitigates some of the effects. It should allow us to interact with the event horizon inside.
node.to: 我们发明的电子手表，减少了一些影响。有了它，我们可以与内部的视界互动

node.id: The situation outside has gone from bad to worse in a matter of weeks. Every day I need to fend off not only the ex-humans, but also people seeking shelter. Meanwhile my employers are only concerned about hiding their wealth in the ground. I managed to photograph one of them kneeling next to a rock in the garden. I've marked the spot so it should be easy to investigate further later on.
node.to: 外面的局势在几周内变得越来越糟糕。每天我不仅要赶走怪物，还要赶走那些寻求庇护的人。与此同时，我的雇主只专注于把他们的财富藏在地下。我设法拍下了其中一个跪在花园岩石旁的照片，我已经标记了该地点，以便以后进一步调查

node.id: I dropped in the weekly shipment as usual. It looks like the food shortage is getting worse and some items aren't available anymore. It's all in the shipping list.
node.to: 我像往常一样顺道送来了每周的货。看起来食物短缺的情况越来越严重，发货单上对的有些东西已经没有了

node.id: There's also another delivery truck with some 'train parts' stuck at the nearby road. There's lockdowns and roadblocks everywhere, and the driver guy said that the truck needs to stay here for a while until everything clears up. I hope it happens soon.
node.to: 在附近的公路上还有另一辆载有“火车零件”的运货卡车。到处都是封锁和路障，司机说卡车需要在这里停留一段时间，直到一切都清理干净。我希望尽快清理好

node.id: Our unit was supposed to provide escort for a convoy with important cargo passing through Pimaville.
node.to: 我们的部队本应护送一队运送重要货物途径皮马维尔的车队

node.id: The problem is that the convoy is already half a day late. Just got confirmation that they haven't reached checkpoint C either. We are not equipped to venture out into that desert to look for them.
node.to: 问题是车队已经迟到了半天，刚刚确认他们也没有到达C检查站。我们也没有装备，不能去沙漠寻找他们

node.id: It seems we just have to wait.
The employees at the train station just called and said that they had been delivered the wrong package.
node.to: 火车站的员工刚刚打电话说他们收到了一个错的包裹

node.id: After some internal investigation we have concluded that there was a mislabeling incident and their package could be in\nany one of these three locations that we delivered cargo to yesterday.
node.to: 经过一些内部调查，我们得知，这次货物发错的原因标签贴错了 \n 他们的包裹可能在我们昨天交付货物的这三个地点中的任何一个
收听 [VAR.required_amount] [ORANGE]皇冠电台的音频日志[WHITE]

node.id: Look for an alternate route to the [ORANGE]Launchpad[WHITE].
node.to: 寻找另一条路线前往 [ORANGE]发射台[WHITE]

node.id: Look around for clues where the key could be.
Listen to the Founder's Mansion [ORANGE]Audio Log[WHITE].
node.to: 聆听创始人官邸 [ORANGE]音频日志[WHITE]

node.id: Listen to the Founder's Office [ORANGE]Audio Log[WHITE].
node.to: 聆听创始人办公室的 [ORANGE]音频日志[WHITE]
[GREEN]搜寻[WHITE] 办公室 [ORANGE]并找到钥匙[WHITE]

node.id: Go to the Escape Pod Launchpad.
Find a way to open [ORANGE]The Fortress[WHITE] gate.
node.to: 找到打开 [ORANGE]王宫[WHITE] 大门方法

node.id: [GREEN]Search[WHITE] for the [ORANGE]Launchpad Key[WHITE] in The Fortress.
node.to: 在王宫 [GREEN]搜寻[WHITE] [ORANGE]发射台的钥匙[WHITE]

node.id: Get past the Volcanic Passage Gate.
Reach the [LOCATION=CALDERA] at the top of the mountain.
A hardened helmet that is a staple of workplace safety in the construction business.

一种异常反光的金属碎片

node.id: I know I haven't been completely honest. I know I may have lied here and there.
node.to: 我知道我没有完全诚实，我知道我可能到处撒谎

node.id: But certain things need to happen in a certain order. I can't risk it.
node.to: 但某些事情需要按照自然发生的顺序，我不能冒进

node.id: We all do what we must just to survive... Just to exist.
node.to: 为了活下去，我们必须做点什么…只是为了活下去…
关于提醒的个人音频日志

node.id: During my refuge I will lose grip of reality.
node.to: 在我避难所时光里，我会失去对现实的把握

node.id: I need to find a way to remind myself of what's important.
node.to: 我需要想办法提醒自己什么是重要的

node.id: Something I can't destroy even when my mind goes to dark places.
node.to: 即使我的思想堕入无尽的黑暗，我也无法被摧毁一些东西

node.id: Something I can't reach until I have regained myself.
node.to: 那些在我恢复之前我无法触及的东西

node.id: The latest iteration of the voice synth is good enough.
node.to: 语音合成器的最新迭代已经足够好了

node.id: The automated broadcasts will start immediately.
Personal audio log. About the timeline of all of this.
node.to: 关于时间线的个人音频日志

node.id: The crash. The Ivory Man and the pestilence. The pyramid. Abby.
node.to: 撞车、象牙人、瘟疫、金字塔，艾比

node.id: After that everything is clear. My reign. The shelter and the escape.
node.to: 之后一切都清楚了，我的统治，避难所和逃生之路

node.id: But lots of questions still remain.
node.to: 但仍有许多问题亟待解决

node.id: How much do I dare stray from my path?
node.to: 我敢在多大程度上偏离我的道路?

node.id: Or do I even have a say in this?
node.to: 或者我在这件事上有发言权吗？
关于死亡的个人音频日志

node.id: I've had plenty of time to contemplate death.
node.to: 我有足够的时间思考死亡

node.id: I don't understand why I am the way I am, but I'm starting to learn the rules.
node.to: 我不明白为什么我会这样，但我开始学习规则了

node.id: I don't know if I can truly die, but I do bleed like everyone else.
node.to: 我不知道我是否真的会死，但我确实和其他人一样会流血

node.id: When I do die, it's only dark for just a moment, and then I feel the Flame.
node.to: 当我死的时候，只是眼前一黑，然后就会回到了营地

node.id: I don't need to eat or sleep, yet I enjoy both.
node.to: 我不需要吃饭或睡觉，但两者我都喜欢

node.id: I always carry the pills with me though. Not repeating that mistake ever again.
node.to: 为了不重蹈覆辙，我总是随身携带着药片
关于神力的个人音频日志

node.id: Mana is extremely valuable. We must not lose this knowledge.
node.to: 神力是非常宝贵的，我们决不能失去这些知识

node.id: I can't wait to share this with the rest of the world.
node.to: 我迫不及待地想和全世界分享这一点

node.id: But we need to overcome the Pestilence first.
node.to: 但我们首先需要战胜瘟疫

node.id: How can I fix this? Or can I even fix this? Are we doomed each time?
node.to: 我怎样才能解决这个问题？或者我能解决这个问题吗？我们每次都是命中注定要失败的吗？

node.id: This is frustrating. Makes me want to break things.
node.to: 这太令人沮丧了，让我想打破一切

node.id: That's it. I'm ready to leave I guess. [EMOJI=neutral face]
node.to: 就这样，我想我已经准备好离开了[EMOJI=neutral face]

node.id: I should inspect more of these. [EMOJI=thinking face]
node.to: 我应该多检查一下 [EMOJI=thinking face]

node.id: This is interesting. I think I need to somehow power up these obelisks.
node.to: 这很有趣，我想我应该激活这些方尖碑

node.id: I should inspect one more for additional clues. [EMOJI=detective]
node.to: 我应该再检查一个，寻找更多的线索 [EMOJI=detective]

node.id: I think I know how to use these now. I should prepare fighting for my life though.
node.to: 我想我现在知道怎么使用这个了，不过我应该准备好为我的生命而战

node.id: The gas is getting to my lungs. I need a [GREEN]Gas Mask[WHITE].
node.to: 气体正在侵入我的肺部，我需要一个 [GREEN]防毒面具[WHITE]

node.id: There are strange obelisks all over the island. Find out if they could be useful somehow.
node.to: 岛上到处都是奇怪的方尖碑，看看它们是否有什么用处

node.id: The obelisks make you stronger, but only one of them can be active at a time. Choose wisely.
node.to: 方尖碑让赋予你更强大的属性，但一次只能激活其中的一个，选择一个你认为最有用的
允许打开和进入 [BLUE]神力裂缝[WHITE]

node.id: A crusty baked seafood pie that has a fresh and crispy taste.
node.to: 一种有新鲜和酥脆味道的硬皮烤海鲜馅饼

node.id: A carefully prepared risotto dish with a fillet of delicious zander on top.

node.to: 这些种子生长一种有可食主根的蔬菜

node.to: 这些种子长成浓密的植物，结有大的可食用的浆果

node.to: 当这些蔬菜种子被种植时，它们最终会在地上长出浓密的叶子

node.id: A four legged, hoofed herbivore mammal found in arctic areas. Popularly known as reindeer.
node.to: 北极地区的一种四足、有蹄的食草动物，俗称驯鹿

node.id: A carrion bird, seen circling above potential prey awaiting their demise.
node.to: 一种食腐鸟类，在潜在猎物上方盘旋等待死亡

node.id: Heavy is the head that bears the crown but heavier yet is the weight of the throne on the backs of those holding it up.
node.to: 王冠是沉重的，但是王冠背后责任是的更沉重

node.id: Law should protect the rights and the needs of the many, not serve the interests of the few.
node.to: 法律应该保护多数人的权利和需要，而不是服务于少数人的利益

node.id: Death does not discriminate, it is the great equalizer. When facing the infinity everyone is on the same line.
node.to: 死亡没有歧视，一切平等。面对芸芸众生，每个人都站在同一条线上

node.id: The act of drawing your weapon is always an easier one to make than the act of sheathing it and ending the violence.
node.to: 拔出武器，以暴制暴，或许比放下屠刀更容易制止暴力

node.id: Towering above his compatriots, the captain of the guard is a ferocious adversary.
node.to: 高大威猛的卫兵队长站，在一群对手中如同鹤立鸡群，确实是一个凶猛的对手

node.id: This ex human uses different types of melee attacks to bring down its target.
node.to: 这个以前也是人类的怪物，使用不同类型的近战攻击来击倒目标

node.id: Highly acrobatic, the leaper is able to pounce upon unsuspecting prey from far away.
node.to: 跳跃者能够从远处突袭毫无戒备的猎物

node.id: The Mutated Hurler has the power to level its surroundings via clusters of explosive projectiles and it almost seems to revel in the mayhem it causes.
node.to: 变异投石怪具备通过爆炸性的炮弹将周围的一切夷为平地的能力，它似乎对自己造成的混乱感到欣喜若狂

node.id: Existing in the darkness below the ground has made the Dweller lose its eyesight. It relies almost purely on sounds for navigation.
node.to: 长期生活地下，黑暗使居住者失去了视力，它几乎完全依靠声音来辨识方向

node.id: A mutated form of a tropical flower that spits out toxic sludge when it senses lifeforms nearby.
node.to: 一种变异的热带植物，当它感觉到危险的时候，会吐出就像淤泥一样恶心的毒液

node.to: 用废木料制造木材和木制品

node.id: Not safe any more! Stay away!

node.to: 私有财产\n象牙山\n禁止入内

node.to: "我们一半的人已经走了。我们必须摧毁这些设备，否则我们都会灭亡！"

node.id: Do not go past the doors without permission!
node.to: 未经允许，不要越过门口!

node.id: I almost blasted myself into smithereens moving these darned barrels. Someone else can do it. I quit!
node.to: 搬动这些该死的桶，差点把自己炸成碎片。让其他人去搬吧，我不干了!

node.to: "本周五是与城镇站工作人员的牌友之夜."

Product ideas for mana?
Gasoline replacement

Fancy warmer for your flippers

Invigorating medicine products

node.to: 另一个链塔，这个生锈的东西看起来很古老 [EMOJI=face with raised eyebrow]

node.id: The potential is limitless! We must get this stuff patented.

node.to: 100% 纯汽油 [EMOJI=fuel pump]\n你可以从气味判断它很好!

node.id: ''Continue exploring further from the town limits. Still dangerous to move around. Fortifying the entrances should be a priority.''

node.to: 百货商店 全天候营业
伯纳德的优质墓碑和纪念品

node.id: "The raft idea is foolhardy. Where do they think they are going to go? So wasteful and I can't stop them."

node.to: 如果桥在上面，使用标有 [GREEN]绿色的神力[WHITE].

node.id: ''Are we alive? Do we even exist anymore?''
node.to: ''我们还活着吗？我们还存在吗？''

node.id: "Folks at the radio station say that they heard voices from their receivers until the power levels to went too low."
node.to: "广播站的人说，他们听到了来自接收器的声音."

node.id: The Radio Royale. Island States' official radio station
node.to: 皇家电台，岛屿官方电台

node.id: "There are at least two other devices, maybe even four. We should be able to map the locations soon enough."
node.to: "至少还有两台其他设备，甚至可能有四台。我们应该很快就能绘制出这些地点的地图"

node.to: "利用特定的无线电共振使晶体变弱的想法非常棒"

node.id: The signal is back! It's weak though.
I should go to check that signal at some point.
node.to: 我应该在某个时候去检查那个信号

node.id: "Wireless transport of matter? Tesla himself wanted nothing to do with this. Not after the incident."
node.to: "物质的无线传输？特斯拉本人不想与此有任何关系，事件发生后就没有了"

node.id: " Mapped using the radio equipment at the station. Thanks guys! "
node.to: "使用电台的无线电设备绘制地图，谢谢大家！ "

node.id: It's a map. I think I can figure this out.
node.to: 这是一张地图，我想我能弄明白

node.to: "人工复制品缺乏天然神力水晶的制质"

node.id: "Part of the structure seems to be completely unobservable."
node.to: "部分结构似乎完全无法观察到"

node.id: I guess I'm not welcome there.
node.to: 我想我在那里不受欢迎

node.id: "I do think that the plan to destroy them all is lunacy!."
node.to: "我确实认为摧毁他们的计划是疯狂的!"

node.id: " The Energy Relays can be [GREEN]Overloaded[WHITE] and that should take care of them. "
node.to: " 能量继电器可以 [GREEN]超载[WHITE] 并且应该可以使用它们"

node.id: " But it should theoretically stop all of the harmful effects."
node.to: " 但从理论上讲，它应该阻止所有的有害影响"

node.id: Destroying the relays sounds like a good plan. I don't get why they are so against it.
node.to: 摧毁继电器听起来是个好计划，但我不明白他们为什么这么反对

node.id: "We still have some electricity coming from somewhere. It shouldn't be possible."
node.to: "我们还有一些电力从某处来，这应该是不可能的"

node.id: There's people here? I wonder if they got out [EMOJI=thinking face]

A Realm on the Edge of Existence, Hidden from the Radiant Sun.

node.id: A Realm of Immeasurable Power, Bound with Existence itself.

node.to: 永生之钥，开启命运之门

node.id: Who wouldn't want a piece of that?
It recites a story of some mythical world.
node.to: 它讲述了一个神话世界的故事
1.《我的水世界求生》是一款休闲动作冒险游戏。本游戏适用于年满12周岁及以上用户，建议未成年人在家长的监护下使用游戏产品
2.在《我的水世界求生》的世界里，玩家通过拆除物品，收集资源，拼凑信息，推进游戏剧情，最终收集到所有能量电池，完成游戏，游戏内部不包含语音系统以及陌生人社交系统
3.本游戏中有用户实名认证系统，未实名账号不能登陆游戏。认证为未成年人的用户将接受以下管理： 未成年玩家可以在周五，周六，周日和法定节假日晚20时至21时登陆游戏，其他时间无法登陆游戏。8周岁以上未满16周岁的用户，单次充值金额不超过50元人民币，每月充值金额累计不得超过200元人民币；16周岁以上未满18周岁的用户，单次充值金额不得超过100元人民币，每月充值金额累计不得超过400元人民币
4.玩家将在《我的水世界求生》里开启一场紧张刺激的动作冒险之旅，解开谜团，努力奋斗，依靠自己的聪明才智逃出生天

node.id: ''The crystals here are hard to mine. Not a lot is usable after it breaks. It just disappears. Reminds me of Prince Rupert's drop actually.''
node.to: ''这里的水晶很难开采，在它坏掉之后，没有多少东西是可用的，它消失了，让我想起了鲁珀特王子的坠落''

node.id: ''The mechanism by which this place captures you is fascinating. It's calling upon your deepest desires and hopes.''
node.to: ''这个地方吸引你的机制很让人着迷，它召唤着你内心最深处的欲望''

node.id: ''I have done it. I now know what Mana is. Or more aptly, I now know what we are. Only one thing left to do.''
node.to: ''我做到了，我现在知道神力是什么了，或者更确切地说，我现在知道我们是什么了，只剩一件事要做了''

node.id: ''The device is dangerous. It is in some unholy symbiosis with this place. Losing my mind. My body is stiffening, breaking apart.''
node.to: ''这个装置很危险，它与这个地方有着某种邪恶的共生关系，失去理智，我的身体变得僵硬，支离破碎''

node.id: ''Half of our people are already gone. We must destroy the devices or we all will perish!''
node.to: ''我们一半的人已经走了，我们必须摧毁这些装置，否则我们都将灭亡!''

node.id: ''A portal opened soon after we arrived. We've been led here and now it wants us to leave.''
node.to: ''我们到达后不久，一个传送门打开了，我们被带到这里，现在它想要我们离开''

node.id: ''The device's healing powers give you the vitality of a young man! We must get closer to them.''
node.to: ''这个装置的治疗能力给你年轻人一般的活力!我们必须靠近他们''

node.id: A Link Tower. The rusty thing looks ancient. [EMOJI=face with raised eyebrow]
node.to: 一个链塔，这个生锈的东西看起来很古老 [EMOJI=face with raised eyebrow]

node.id: Someone really wanted to shut it down. I have a suspicion that it didn't help. [EMOJI=worried face]
node.to: 有人真的想把它关掉，我怀疑这并没有帮助 [EMOJI=worried face]

node.id: It's alive! The radiation is back [EMOJI=grimacing face]
node.to: 它还活着！辐射又回来了 [EMOJI=grimacing face]

node.id: Shouldn't be too hard to fix. [EMOJI=thinking face]
''The nicked Crown Tower works well enough as a test bench. I hope they don't come looking for it.''
node.to: ''有裂缝的皇冠塔作为一个测试台已经足够好了。我希望它们不要来找它''

node.id: A demonstration for the Energy Relays is scheduled for next monday.
node.to: 下周一将举行能量继电器的演示

node.id: ''We should receive another steel delivery from the [LOCATION=DLC1_FACTORY] next week.''
node.to: ''下周[LOCATION=DLC1_FACTORY]我们应该会收到另一批钢材''

node.id: I think this place really does not want me here any more. [EMOJI=loudly crying face]
node.to: 我觉得这个地方真的不想再让我待在这里了 [EMOJI=loudly crying face]

node.id: That's what you get for breaking things I guess. [EMOJI=frowning face]
node.to: 我猜这就是摔东西的下场吧 [EMOJI=frowning face]

node.id: 100% pure APEX brand gasoline [EMOJI=fuel pump]\nYou can tell by the smell that it's good!
node.to: 100%纯APEX品牌汽油 [EMOJI=fuel pump]\n闻起来就知道品质不错!

node.id: ''Some kind of symbiosis between the foreign devices and this world. It's using them to lure and trap the living over vast distances?''
node.to: ''外来设备和这个世界之间的某种共生关系，它利用它们来引诱和诱捕远距离的生物?''

node.id: ''The connection between the displacing blue radiation and the energy relays is certain.''
node.to: ''切断蓝色的辐射和能量继电器之间的联系是确信的''

node.id: ''Artificial mana crystals are practically useless and disposing of them has proven problematic. The distinct color is easy to spot though.''
node.to: ''人造神力水晶实际上是无用的，如何处理他们也存在问题。明显的颜色差异很容易被发现''

node.id: ''Mana acts like it's a living thing by itself. Its growth must be nurtured.''
node.to: ''神力就像一个有生命的东西，它的成长必须得到培育''

node.id: ''I do think that the plan to destroy them all is lunacy!.''
node.to: ''我确实认为摧毁他们的计划是疯狂的！''

node.id: ''[ORANGE]The Energy Relays[WHITE] can be [GREEN]Overloaded[WHITE] and that should take care of them.''
node.to: ''[ORANGE]能量继电器[WHITE] 可能 [GREEN]过载[WHITE]，需要小心应对''

node.id: ''But It should theoretically stop all of the harmful effects.''
node.to: ''但理论上它应该能阻止所有的负面效果''

node.id: So that's what those things are called. Destroying them sounds like a plan if I want to get to that [ORANGE]Signal source[WHITE].
node.to: 这就是这些东西的召唤，如果我能找到 [ORANGE]信号源[WHITE]的话，摧毁它们听起来像是个不错的计划

node.id: ''The idea about using specific radio resonance to make the crystals weaker was brilliant.''
node.to: ''利用特殊的无线电共振使晶体变弱的想法是非常聪明的''

node.id: Due care must be exercised near the automatic door.
node.to: 在靠近自动门的地方必须格外小心

node.id: ''I've become quite savvy at climbing during my time here. Out of necessity I suppose.''
node.to: ''在这里的这段时间里，我对攀岩已经相当熟练了。我想是出于必要吧''

node.id: The signal is gone. [EMOJI=face with raised eyebrow] I should look around to see if I can find it again. Maybe it will show up.
node.to: 信号消失了[EMOJI=face with raised eyebrow] 我应该四处看看能不能再找到它，也许它会出现

node.id: The Signal is coming from somewhere here. [EMOJI=compass]
I'm starting to feel adventurous! I should explore the area further. [EMOJI=]
node.to: 我开始有冒险精神了！我应该进一步探索这个地区 [EMOJI=]

node.id: What was that? It looks like the door opened.
So that World really exists? I'd like to stay on the side of the living though.
node.to: 所以世界真的存在?不过我还是想待在活人这边

node.id: Unlimited power? Who wouldn't want a piece of that? I feel like I should go through.
node.to: 无限的能量?谁不想分一杯羹呢?我觉得我应该

node.id: Someone definitely made a big blunder. It isn't a welcoming place I'm sure.
node.to: 肯定有人犯了个大错误，我敢肯定那不是一个欢迎你的地方

node.id: ''The strange people almost got us. We saw a giant fireball streaking across the sky. Better to stay hidden for now.''
node.to: ''那些奇怪的人差点抓住我们，我们看到一个巨大的火球划过天，最好是暂时藏起来''

node.id: ''Three of us made it before it closed. But everything is different up there. It's all wrong.''
node.to: ''我们三个人在关门前赶到了，但在那里一切都不一样了，全错了''

node.id: It goes even deeper! Shouldn't be far now [EMOJI=thinking face]
node.to: 它走的更深了!现在应该不远了 [EMOJI=thinking face]

node.id: I'm starting to feel adventurous! I should explore the area further.
node.to: 我开始有冒险精神了！我应该进一步探索这个地区

Where the Magic of Mana rules. Where Life and Death are Equals.
Heed the words of warning at the Catacombs, if you choose to travel to the Underworld.
A Perilous Realm Corrupted and Defiled by the Greediness of Mortals.
node.to: 可怜的凡人终将被贪婪腐蚀

node.id: The Wellspring of Mana. Now Unbound, Untethered.
Go through the Gate of Mist at the Catacombs, if you choose to travel to the Underworld.
node.to: 穿过迷雾之门，往生冥界

node.id: A Key to Everlasting Life. A Way to Alter the Strands of Fate.
node.to: 永生之钥，开启命运之门

node.id: The Doc says that this must be the way out.
I hope he is right, for all of our sakes.
node.to: 我希望他是对的，为了我们所有人

node.id: They surmise that the passage needs to be opened from both sides.
node.to: 他们推测通道需要从两边打开

node.id: Getting out could take months or even years...
node.to: 越狱可能需要数月甚至数年时间...

node.id: Luckily our people are very resourceful.
node.to: 幸运的是，我们的人神通广大.

node.id: The tools they have crafted have been very useful so far.
node.to: 到目前为止，他们制作的工具非常有用.

node.id: Don Cook, Documenting for Radio Royale.
node.to: 唐·库克，为皇冠广播电台记录

node.id: I have tried to piece together a theory on what the heck happened.
node.to: 我试图拼凑出一个理论来解释到底发生了什么事

node.id: That darn Ivory Mountain firm is the guilty party, that's for sure.
node.to: 象牙山那家该死的公司无疑是有罪的一方

node.id: I don't think that even the Crown knew of what they were scheming.
node.to: 我想连皇冠都不知道他们在策划什么

node.id: The man behind the operation could even be trapped here with us.
node.to: 行动背后的人甚至可能和我们一起被困在这里

node.id: Some folks sure would like to lay their hands on him.
node.to: 有些人肯定会对他下手

node.id: Audio recording over. Don Cook for Radio Royale.
node.to: 录音结束，皇冠广播电台唐·库克

node.id: Apparently the blue radiation on the hill transports people to this station.
node.to: 显然，是山上的蓝色辐射将人们传到了这个站点

node.id: As to why here exactly, well that is still shrouded in mystery.
node.to: 至于为什么会出现在这里，这仍然是一个谜

node.id: Recent discoveries have given us some ideas though.
node.to: 不过，最近的发现给了我们一些思路

node.id: Doc and our few engineers are slowly trying to crack the case.
node.to: 博士和我们为数不多的几个工程师正慢慢地试图探究真相

node.id: We still have no clue what happened to the poor fellas who did not arrive here.
node.to: 我们仍然不知道那些没有到达这里的可怜的家伙发生了什么

node.id: More of our foodstuffs have gone missing.
node.to: 我们更多的食品不见了

node.id: The people on the other side of the town are becoming desperate.
node.to: 城镇另一边的人们正变得绝望

node.id: Fighting each other is futile. It just wastes our resources.
node.to: 互相争斗是徒劳的，只会浪费我们的资源

node.id: We should be working together on getting out of this wretched place.
node.to: 我们应该一起努力离开这个该死的地方

node.id: There's a rumor that some people plan to make tracks and skip town.
node.to: 有传言说有些人打算逃跑

node.id: The place is getting dangerous, so I think I should vamoose with them.
node.to: 这地方越来越危险了，我想我应该跟他们一起走

node.id: The escapees must have found another one of those energy link gadgets.
node.to: 逃亡者一定找到了另一个能量能量继电器

node.id: One should be kept close at all times if you plan to survive out there.
node.to: 如果你想在外面生存，就应该时刻保持安全距离

node.id: No sign of the original inhabitants. Lucky me.
node.to: 没有原住民的踪迹，太好了

node.id: I'm starting to think that this joint might actually be haunted!
node.to: 我开始觉得这个地方可能真的闹鬼了！

node.id: We got pounced on by... uh... spirits?
Never seen anything like them before.
node.to: 以前从没见过这样的东西

node.id: I was pursued by one for so long I got separated from the main gang.
node.to: 我被其中一个追了很久，以至于和大部队走散了

node.id: I'm not so sure I can get back to safety with those... things out there.
node.to: 我不确定我能回到安全的地方…那些东西就在外面

node.id: I'm starting to think Doc ain't who he claims to be.
node.to: 我开始觉得博士不单是明面上显露的身份

node.id: He knows far more about our situation than he's let us on.
node.to: 他知道的情况比他告诉我们的要多得多

node.id: The man exhibits an intuitive knowledge of exploitation of mana.
node.to: 这个人对神力的利用有直观的认识

node.id: There might even be a connection between him and the event that brought us here.
node.to: 甚至他跟我们来到这里，可能都有千丝万缕的联系

node.id: Doc is playing his own game and the goal ain't getting out of this place.
node.to: 博士正在一步步实现他自己的目的，而不是想从这里出去

node.id: People are starting to succumb to the effects of the mana.
node.to: 人们开始屈服于神力的影响了

node.id: Usage of the energy link gadgets has turned them against us.
node.to: 它们使用的能量继电器对我们非常不利

node.id: They kept us strong and alive for so long.
node.to: 他们让我们强大，并且存活了这么久

node.id: But like with everything, there is a cost attached.
node.to: 但就像所有东西一样，必然需要付出相应的代价

node.id: There are enemies near. It's not safe to use the device.
node.to: 附近有敌人，无法安全使用该设备

node.id: I think this is actually a way to go to that place.
node.to: 我认为这实际上是通往那个地方的一种途径

node.id: More guidance. A warning this time.
It's a kind of cautious guide on how to travel to some mysterious place.
node.to: 这是一本关于如何去神秘地方旅行的安全指南

node.id: I need to build a doorway here first.

node.to: 首先需要拆除在上面的建筑

node.to: 安装 [ORANGE]营地快速传送[WHITE] 在区域 [ORANGE]链塔[WHITE]上，用以开启 [GREEN]快速传送[WHITE]

node.id: Activate this Point of Interest first.
This looks like a place where some low-life could live. Only one way to find out. [EMOJI=index pointing up]
node.to: 这里看起来像是一些下等人住的地方，只有一条路[EMOJI=index pointing up]

node.id: There's a note here that says [ORANGE]UNDER[WHITE]
node.to: 这里有张纸条上写着 [ORANGE]地下[WHITE]

node.id: I should try and [GREEN]Overload[WHITE] that closest one first for testing purposes.
node.to: 为了测试的目的，我应该尝试[GREEN]过载[WHITE]最接近的那个

node.id: And now to find the rest of them [GREEN]Energy Relays[WHITE].
node.to: 现在找到其余的[GREEN]能量继电器[WHITE]

node.id: And now to find the rest of those [GREEN]Energy Relays[WHITE].
node.to: 现在找到其余的[GREEN]能量继电器[WHITE]

node.id: The antenna was equipped with a [ORANGE]Campfire Triangulation[WHITE] transmitter.
node.to: 发射器配备了一个[ORANGE]营地快速传送[WHITE]的功能模块

node.id: Destroying those relays must have broken it. Shouldn't be too hard to replace.
node.to: 摧毁那些继电器的时候一定是把这个功能模块弄坏了，替换应该不会太难

node.id: It's allowing me to move at speed of thought between the campfires.
node.to: 它让我能够在营地之间，所念即所至的快速传送

node.id: The link tower was equipped with a [ORANGE]Campfire Triangulation[WHITE] transmitter.
node.to: 链塔装备了 [ORANGE]营地快速传送[WHITE] 的发射器功能模块

node.id: It's broken, but I think It can be replaced. [EMOJI=thinking face]
node.to: 它坏了，但我想可以维修 [EMOJI=thinking face]

node.id: That should come handy. Maybe it works on those other towers too?
node.to: 这应该能派上很大的用处，也许它也适用于其他链塔？

node.id: There's people here? I wonder if they got out. [EMOJI=thinking face]
node.to: 这里有人吗?我想知道他们是否逃出来了 [EMOJI=thinking face]

node.id: A modern [GREEN]keycard[WHITE]? No wonder they referred to the key as 'strange'.

node.id: A community of thieves lived by taking advantage of others. Fortunately for you, you can't take anything with you after you are dead

[GREEN]调查[WHITE] 坐落在 [LOCATION=DLC1_VALLEY_1]的建筑，寻找线索

node.id: Locate the [GREEN]Thieves Hideout[WHITE] in the south.
node.to: 找出位于[WHITE]南边的[GREEN]盗贼藏身之处

node.id: Mana Chambers have many unnatural effects. The undead rise again, the once strong are now weak and their deaths reward you with generous spoils.
node.to: 神力室有许多超自然的异象。在这些复活的亡灵面前，你不再强大，但消灭它们会获得丰厚的战利品

node.id: [GREEN]Kill[WHITE] monsters inside Mana Chamber and [GREEN]Use[WHITE] it again to raise the dead back to life.
node.to: [GREEN]击败[WHITE] 神力室中的怪物，当再次 [GREEN]激活[WHITE] 神力室会让死亡的怪物复活

node.id: Some enemies in the [ORANGE]Underworld[WHITE] are Infused with Mana. This makes them tougher until the protective shielding is broken away.
node.to: [ORANGE]地下世界[WHITE] 的怪物被灌注了神力，这使得它们更强大，除非神力护盾被打破

node.id: Mana makes the infused enemies tougher and resistant to slashing weapons, but clever use of the other tools available should take care of them.
node.to: 神力的注入能让让敌人变得更强大，并免疫近战武器的伤害，但巧妙地使用其他可用工具应该能解决这些问题
使用增强型种子袋种植

node.id: Planting crops with Enhanced Seed Bag improves your harvesting speed and makes it possible to grow Mana Beads.
node.to: 使用增强型种子袋种植作物可以提高种植速度，并使种植神力珠成为可能
发明制作 [GREEN]增强种子袋种[WHITE]

node.id: Plant [GREEN]Mana Seeds[WHITE] using the Enhanced Seed Bag.
node.to: 使用增强型种子袋种植 [GREEN]神力珠[WHITE]

node.id: Destroy 4 Mana Spirits while inside an active Mana Chamber.
node.to: 在一个激活的神力密室中消灭4个神力之魂

node.id: You come up to a small village that is decorated with a hodgepodge of items from seemingly different time periods.
node.to: 你来到一个小村庄，这里装饰着来自不同年代的各种物品

node.id: You climb down into the 'vault'. It is definitely of modern make, which does raise some big questions.
node.to: 你爬下“宝库”，这确实有个巨大的疑问：它肯定是现代制造的
找到[GREEN]藏匿处[WHITE]的[GREEN]奇怪的钥匙[WHITE]

node.id: Find a door which accepts the [GREEN]Green Keycard[WHITE].
node.to: 找到可以用[GREEN]绿色钥匙卡[WHITE]打开的门

node.id: Fast travel between campfires have been fully unlocked. Find any link tower and install a Campfire Triangulation transmitter.
node.to: 营地之间的快速传送已经完全解锁，在任何一个链塔的发射器，安装一个营地快速传送的功能模块

node.id: Campfires in this link tower area can now be used for fast travel.
node.to: 现在这个链塔区域的营地之间可以快速传送了

node.to: [ORANGE]利用营地[WHITE][GREEN]快速传送[WHITE]到其他营地

node.id: Inhabiting the plains of the Underworld, the ghostly Mana Spirit can only be made vulnerable with special mana weapons and chambers.
node.to: 肆虐在地下世界的平原上，如同幽灵般的神力精灵只能通过特殊的神力武器和神力室变得脆弱

node.id: Powerful ranged weapon for clearing things from afar.
node.to: 强大的远程武器，用来清除远处的敌人

node.id: A tiny cup that protects from being pricked or poked by spiky enemies and obstacles.
node.to: 保护自己不被尖刺敌人或障碍物刺到的小指套

node.id: Enables using Home Portal outside the main island.
node.to: 允许在主岛之外的地方使用家园传送器

node.id: A small set of internal walls to help divide your home into rooms.
node.to: 一组小的内墙，帮助划分房间

node.id: What are these [GREEN]Link Towers[WHITE] doing here? [EMOJI=thinking face]
node.to: 这些[GREEN]链塔[WHITE] 在这里做什么? [EMOJI=thinking face]

node.id: Is it some kind of an old antenna? It's radiating energy! [EMOJI=drooling face]
node.to: 这是什么旧天线吗?它正发射着能量! [EMOJI=drooling face]

node.id: It's some kind of an old antenna? It's radiating energy! [EMOJI=drooling face]
node.to: 这是什么旧天线吗?它正发射着能量! [EMOJI=drooling face]

node.id: Locked! There is a thin slot at the base of the hatch which could fit a [GREEN]card of some sort[WHITE]
node.to: 锁上了!在舱口的底部有一个很薄的卡槽，可以放一张[GREEN]某种卡片之类的东西[WHITE]
我的传送问题还没解决 [EMOJI=frowning face]
什么?发生了什么事? [EMOJI=worried face]

node.id: A huge sinkhole, but what is that at the bottom?
node.to: 一个巨大的天坑，底下到底是什么?

node.id: This must be the red house around which I can find the [GREEN]strange key[WHITE]!
node.to: 这座红色的房子，在它周围一定可以找到 [GREEN]奇怪的钥匙[WHITE]!

node.id: The scavenged table of chemical elements contains some previously unknown and peculiar substances.
node.to: 被清除的化学元素表包含一些以前未知的特殊物质

node.id: ''Oh my. All this commotion and strangeness. Well i do have my needlepoint hobby to keep my spirits up.''
node.to: ''哦…天哪，所有这些喧闹和陌生…好吧，我有我的爱好可以让我振作起来''

node.id: The [ORANGE]vault[WHITE] continues to provide. This soft drink dispenser is truly a marvel of engineering! The drink ain't half bad either.
node.to: [ORANGE]宝库[WHITE]持续供应，这个饮料自动售货机真是个工程奇迹！这饮料也不错

node.id: As a safeguard, deposit the [GREEN]strange key[WHITE] in a stash behind the red house overlooking the windmill.
node.to: 为了安全起见，那把[GREEN]奇怪的钥匙[WHITE]被藏在了可以俯瞰风车的红房子后面

node.id: While it seems apparent that these devices are powered by electricity, they are far too sophisticated. They seem like they were manufactured after our time...
node.to: 虽然这些设备显然是由电力驱动的，但它们太复杂了，它们似乎是在未来制造出来的...

node.id: It's a whole town! Or at least a very big chunk of one. [EMOJI=exploding head]
node.to: 整个城镇！或者至少是一大部分 [EMOJI=exploding head]

node.id: At first this place felt like a dream and I thought I would soon wake up back home in [ORANGE]Sunburn Desert[WHITE]. Perhaps that distant home was itself a dream?
node.to: 起初，这个地方感觉像一个梦，我想我很快就会在[ORANGE]炙热沙漠[WHITE]的家中醒来，但也许那个遥远的家本身也是一个梦?

node.id: Ever since the stairs broke down I've had to live on a diet of eggs. Luckily, the local birds seem to prefer this cliff as a nesting site.
node.to: 自从楼梯坏了以后，我就不得不靠吃鸡蛋为生。幸运的是，当地的鸟类似乎很喜欢这个悬崖作为筑巢地

node.id: The board contains different dates combined with scouting reports. There was a lookout here.
node.to: 上面有不同的日期的侦查报告，这里有个瞭望台

node.id: There's the campfire. Can't be that far now. [EMOJI=compass]
node.to: 那儿有个营地，应该不远了 [EMOJI=compass]

node.id: ''The nicked Crown Tower works well enough as a test bench. I hope they don't come looking for them.''
node.to: ''有裂缝的皇冠链塔作为一个测试台已经足够好了，我希望他们不会来找它''

node.id: ''Here are the requested materials. Now would you be so kind and do the repairs in haste. The alternate route is vexing.
node.to: ''这是您要的材料，现在你能不能行行好赶紧修理一下？备用线路真的是很烦人

node.id: It's a whole town! Or at least very big chunk of it. [EMOJI=exploding head]
node.to: 整个城镇！或者至少是一大部分 [EMOJI=exploding head]

node.id: ''There still has been nothing whatsoever happening at the tower. I am shocked as always.''
node.to: ''塔上居然没有发生任何事情，我一如既往地感到震惊''

node.id: How did they get the rock on top of this?
node.to: 他们是怎么把石头弄到这上面的？

node.id: ''More and more thieves are sneaking around these days. I wonder if troubles in the town are getting worse.''
node.to: ''这些天越来越多偷偷摸摸的小偷，我不知道镇上的问题是否越来越严重了''

node.id: Someone had a really bad day.
That sparkling jolt of electricity feels strange to touch, like my heartbeats suddenly grew slower.
node.to: 那种闪闪发光的电流触碰起来感觉很奇怪，就像我的心跳突然变慢了

node.id: I should have believed you when you said to sell my suit and tie and to come and live with you. Instead I ended up in another world or something.
node.to: 当你说要卖掉我的西装和领带，搬来和你一起住的时候，我就应该相信你的。结果我却来到了另一个世界

node.id: ''Those darn thieves took my precious! They must have taken it to their hideout in the south. I'm never getting it back.''
node.to: ''那些该死的小偷偷走了我的宝贝！他们一定是把它带到他们在南边的藏身之处了。我再也拿不回来了''

node.id: Maybe I should take a look. I hope it's not too far away.
node.to: 也许我应该看一下，我希望不会太远

node.id: ''Connecting the door with the tower was trivial.''
node.to: ''把门和塔连接起来微不足道''

node.id: There's something familiar here at least. Looks strange though. [EMOJI=face with raised eyebrow]
node.to: 这里至少有一些熟悉的东西，不过看起来很奇怪 [EMOJI=face with raised eyebrow]

node.id: I should go to see what's so special about those towers.
node.to: 我应该去看看那些塔有什么特别之处

node.id: I should go to check that signal at some point.
node.to: 我该找个时间去看看那个信号

node.id: ''This crown tower requires some kind of tool to operate beyond basic functions. No luck in cracking it so far.''
node.to: ''这个皇冠塔需要某种工具来完成基本功能之外的操作，目前为止还没找到''

node.id: ''Note to self. Get materials for fixing the roof.''
''Isn't assembling this energy whatchamacallit a bit early? The building isn't even ready yet.''
node.to: ''集结这股能量是不是有点早了?大楼还没准备好呢''

node.id: There's a note here that says [ORANGE]TARP[WHITE]
node.to: 这里有张纸条上写着 [ORANGE]陷阱[WHITE]

node.id: Some scoundrels had a meeting here.
''Boss hides the treasure and gives us [ORANGE]three clues[WHITE] for the location. Check. Hide your clue in a house shown on the board. Check. Get rid of the evidence. On it.''
node.to: ''Boss藏起了宝藏，并给了我们留下[ORANGE]三条线索[WHITE]。线索就在屋内的黑板上，看完销毁证据''

node.id: Looks simple enough. I should check these places for those clues.
node.to: 看起来很简单，我应该去这些地方看看有没有线索

node.id: ''Hide your clues in these locations. And remember, don't tell anyone or else!''
node.to: ''把你的线索藏在这些地方。记住，不要告诉其他任何人!''

node.id: ''Everyone should learn to organize their plunderage better. We are civilized people here!''
node.to: ''每个人都应该学会更好地组织偷盗，我们是这里的文明人!''

node.id: Lorne's booty and business. Bargaining for your life has never been easier.
node.to: 洛恩的战利品和生意。讨价还价从未如此容易过

node.id: I found it! Hidden in plain sight. [EMOJI=victory hand]
node.to: 我找到它了！就隐藏在众目睽睽之下 [EMOJI=victory hand]

node.id: ''Getting a little tight in this joint. More fools are taking the easy road and trying to live off theft. Their loss.''
node.to: ''这里的生活越来越艰难了，更多的傻瓜迷失了自己，妄图选择一条捷径，以偷窃为生''

node.id: There's a note here that says [ORANGE]ROAD[WHITE]
node.to: 这里有张纸条上写着 [ORANGE]道路[WHITE]

node.id: How could anyone live here? [EMOJI=flushed face]
node.to: 怎么会有人住在这里? [EMOJI=flushed face]

node.id: This isn't a vault but a shelter from modern day!
node.to: 这不是一个宝库，而是来自现代的庇护所!

node.id: Location unknown, no contact with the base back at the [ORANGE]Three Sisters[WHITE]. My only theory is that overcharging the [GREEN]Blue Eye Orb[WHITE] must have caused some sort of quantum event.
node.to: 位置未知，与 [ORANGE]三姐妹[WHITE]基地没有联系。我唯一能想到的推测是过度充能 [GREEN]蓝眼球[WHITE] ，导致了某种量子突变

node.id: The sad reality is that we aren't probably going to get back home. We need to try to adapt and expand the existing shelter.
node.to: 可悲的现实是，我们可能回不了家了。我们需要尝试适应和扩大现有的庇护所

node.id: Do not venture outside alone! Always group up as it is a hostile environment up there.
node.to: 不要独自外出冒险！一定要组队，因为那里的环境很恶劣

node.id: [AMOUNT] XP already gained from this quest.
node.to: 任务已获取[AMOUNT] 经验值

node.id: But where did I go this time?
I should look around. Maybe this place can give some answers.
node.to: 我应该四处看看。也许这个地方能给我们一些答案

node.to: 这可不太好！我要阻止那枚导弹发射！

node.id: Terminal is on the other side. Perhaps there is a way around?
node.to: 终端在另一侧，也许有一条绕过去的路？
德西玛应急发电机终端

node.id: I need to find some alternate way to get across.
node.to: 我需要找到其他的过河方式

node.id: This place has suffered massive damage. There is no way I can get past that!
node.to: 这个地方遭受了巨大的破坏，我无法通过那里！

node.id: I better check out if this final platform has [GREEN]anything of value[WHITE] and then I should be free to leave. Whew!
node.to: 我最好检查一下最后这个平台是否有任何 [GREEN]有价值[WHITE] 的东西再离开，呼!

node.id: Biohazard threat level nominal. Quarantine lifted. Resume your normal activities and have a great day!
node.to: 生物危害威胁等级正常，解除隔离，恢复正常活动，祝你度过美好的一天！

node.id: The town seems to have done pretty well to warrant expansion. [EMOJI=construction]
node.to: 这个城镇似乎发展得很好，值得扩建 [EMOJI=construction]

node.id: Patients just keep coming in day after day. It seems there is some unknown contagion going around. The base personnel are also suspiciously quiet about it.
node.to: 每天都有新增病例，似乎有某种未知的传染病在蔓延，基地人员对此也保持着令人怀疑的沉默

node.id: Delve into the exquisite world of Truffles at 'Le Petit Cochon'.
node.to: 在小猪葡萄酒餐厅你可以尽情享受松露的美味

node.id: Is this some kind of a prison? [EMOJI=face screaming in fear]
node.to: 这是什么样的监狱？ [EMOJI=face screaming in fear]

node.id: This terminal requires [YELLOW]Yellow Keycard[WHITE] to function.
node.to: 此终端需要 [YELLOW]黄色钥匙卡[WHITE] 才能激活

node.id: For some reason the turrets don't seem to target Ex-Humans. Is it the presence of Mana in the circuitry that is causing a malfunction?
node.to: 出于某种原因，炮塔似乎不以变异者为目标，是电路中神力的存在导致了故障吗？

node.id: This place is pretty expensively decorated! [EMOJI=gem stone]
node.to: 这个地方装修相当昂贵！[EMOJI=gem stone]

node.id: This prison doesn't seem to be in conjunction with any research laboratories. [EMOJI=detective]
node.to: 这个监狱似乎与任何研究实验室都没有关联 [EMOJI=detective]

node.id: [BLUE]The missile[WHITE] will be left in an inert state. We can always reactivate and launch it remotely if need be.
node.to: [BLUE]导弹[WHITE] 将被保持静止状态，如果需要，我们随时可以重新激活并远程发射

node.id: We should consider it an insurance in case things go awry with beheading the [GREEN]Crown back home[WHITE].
node.to: 我们应该将其视为一种保险，以防在斩首皇冠后出现问题

node.id: "Next clue is at [GREEN]a bedroom overlooking the jungle at J11[WHITE]."
node.to: "下一个线索在 [GREEN]J11[WHITE] 面向俯瞰丛林的小屋"

node.id: There is description of an incident here where a cargo drone went off course with "live" cargo and crashed on the western portion of [ORANGE]The Island[WHITE].
node.to: 这里有一个事件的描述，一架载着"活体"的货运无人机偏离了航线，在[ORANGE]岛屿的西部[WHITE]坠毁

node.id: I wish I could remember my family at all. The time spent in the pyramid slowly faded all my memories away. [EMOJI=broken heart]
node.to: 我真希望我还能记得我的家人，在金字塔里的时光慢慢地褪去了我所有的记忆 [EMOJI=broken heart]

node.id: I think that at this point we can cross out [ORANGE]"Three Sisters"[WHITE] as a costly mistake and return back to [ORANGE]The Motherland[WHITE].
node.to: 我认为在这一点上，我们可以把 [ORANGE]"三姐妹"[WHITE] 视为一个代价高昂的错误并返回 [ORANGE]祖国[WHITE]

node.id: We'll let father take the blame and pick up the pieces, just like last time.
node.to: 我们会让父亲承担责任并收拾残局，就像上次一样

node.id: The fact that this ancient technology still works at all is an excellent testament to how wondrous of a power source mana really is!
node.to: 这种古老的技术依然能够运转，证明了神力是一种多么神奇的能量来源！

node.id: Another one of those drones... perhaps this will help me get across to the last island!
node.to: 又一个无人机…或许这会帮助我到达最后一个岛屿！

node.id: The next clue: [GREEN]Source of the water spill at G7[WHITE].
node.to: 下一个线索：[GREEN]G7区域泄漏的油桶[WHITE]

node.id: This is the first time I've seen an open air tomb. [EMOJI=moai]
node.to: 这是我第一次看到露天的墓地 [EMOJI=moai]

node.id: "Creative Struggles: Ponderings And Musings" - a theory book on overcoming writer's block.
node.to: " 创造性的挣扎：思考和沉思" — 一本关于克服写作障碍的理论书籍

node.id: This looks like a pretty sizable settlement. Why would people choose to hole up out here, though?
node.to: 这看起来是一个相当大的定居点，但是为什么人们会选择躲藏在这里呢？

node.id: Yesterday I was working with cutting edge technology and now look at me! I am trying to pick apart toasters in hopes of finding some electronic scrap to craft a makeshift radio!
node.to: 昨天我还在使用尖端科技，现在看看我！我正在拆解烤面包机，希望能找到一些电子废料，制作一个临时的收音机！

node.id: Next clue is [GREEN]Inside the yellow tent at I9[WHITE].
node.to: 下一个线索是 [GREEN]在I9的黄色帐篷里[WHITE]
[RED]光束枪[WHITE] 单缝实验-第66次测试.
[RED]光束枪[WHITE] 工业评估-第87次测试.

node.id: Location unknown, no contact with the base back at the [ORANGE]Three Sisters[WHITE]. My only theory is that overcharging the [BLUE]Blue Eye Orb[WHITE] must have caused some sort of quantum event.
node.to: 位置未知，与 [ORANGE]三姐妹[WHITE] 研究基地失去了联系，我唯一的猜测是过度充电 [BLUE]蓝眼球[WHITE] 一定引起了某种量子事件

node.id: You always did have too many names.

node.to: 这不禁让我想起了往事

node.id: Sleep tight. Time to awake soon.
node.to: 睡个好觉，很快就要醒来了

node.id: The Pale Protocol will only work if all of the mana infestation on the Island has been taken care of.
node.to: 苍白协议只有将岛屿上所有的神力感染的怪物都解决后才能生效

node.id: These elevators lead nowhere. This section wasn't completed in time.
node.to: 这些电梯哪儿都去不了，这部分没有及时完成

node.id: Everything is carefully placed. I wish there had been more Mana to build extra campfires.
node.to: 一切都被安置妥当，我希望有更多的神力来建造额外的营地

node.id: Evacuation proceeding as planned. Rendezvous at Point Phoenix.
node.to: 撤离按计划进行中，在菲尼克斯汇合

node.id: All equipment calibrated. Time Recoil within safety limits.
node.to: 所有设备已校准，时间回溯在安全范围内

node.id: Everyone will be provided safe transit.
node.to: 将为每个人提供安全的交通工具

node.id: You find an audio log from a person that was evidently employed in the [ORANGE]Three Sisters Research Complex[WHITE]. Perhaps there are more to be found, scattered across the archipelago.
node.to: 你找到了一份音频日志，显然是由一个在 [ORANGE]三姐妹研发中心[WHITE] 工作过的人员留下的，也许还有更多散落在群岛上

node.id: The audio logs from Jonah paint a grim picture of what was going on in [ORANGE]Three Sisters[WHITE]. Judging by the current state of things, he might have not found a way out.
node.to: 乔纳的音频日志描述了 [ORANGE]三姐妹研发中心[WHITE] 正在发生的可怕事情，根据目前的情况来看，他可能没能逃出来

node.id: Tectonic shifts in the archipelago have unearthed multiple veins of gold, making the process of extracting it quite easy.
node.to: 该群岛的地质构造变化出多条裸露地表的黄金矿脉，这使得采集金矿的过程变得相当容易

node.id: You find a [BLUE]Blue Keycard[WHITE] hidden among the leaves. It seems apparent that it might open some as of yet unknown passage.
node.to: 你在一堆纸张里发现了一张 [BLUE]蓝色钥匙卡[WHITE]，它显然可以打开一些未知的门

node.id: The botanical laboratory contains partial research into [BLUE]mystical properties[WHITE] of certain species of flowers that were exposed to pollen infused with mana.
node.to: 植物实验室在进行某些品种花朵的 [BLUE]神秘属性[WHITE] 的研究，这些花卉曾暴露于注入神力的花粉中

node.id: The fabricator produces a single vial filled with a glowy substance ready for ingestion.
node.to: 制造机生产了一个充满荧光的小瓶，可以直接服用

node.id: Concrete platforms in the water led to a gate, surrounded by building materials. Explore the structures further for clues to their purpose.
node.to: 水中的混凝土平台通向一扇大门，周围是建筑材料，深入探索这些建筑，以了解它们的用途

node.id: The lab coat you found will help protect you from any potential dangers you may face in your upcoming challenges.
node.to: 你找到的实验室外套将帮助你保护自己免受可能出现的危险

node.id: [GREEN]Find[WHITE] the [ORANGE]Coastlab Terminal Key[WHITE] at [ORANGE]Coastlab Security Station[WHITE]
node.to: 在 [GREEN]海岸实验室保安站[WHITE] 寻找 [ORANGE]海岸实验室终端钥匙[WHITE]

node.id: Some [GREEN]mechanical contraption[WHITE] flies over your location and continues towards [ORANGE]an unknown destination[WHITE]. Perhaps this could be your way out of the Island?
node.to: 一些 [GREEN]无人机[WHITE] 从你头上飞过，飞往了 [ORANGE]未知的目的地[WHITE]，也许这是你离开这个岛屿的方式？

node.id: You have survived the challenges of the Hidden Archipelago and while doing so averted a catastrophe on a global scale. Next to you is another drone ready to take you back the Island as you still have unfinished business.
node.to: 你已经成功地度过了隐藏的群岛的挑战,在此过程中避免了全球性的灾难.你身边还有另一个无人机准备带你回到岛上,因为你还有未完成的任务.

node.id: The Legend of the Magic Sword

The book in front of you contains an excerpt of a journal detailing a group of friends embarking on a 'quest' to find an alleged [RED]'magical sword'[WHITE]. The text mentions that a [GREEN]'likeness of a Death Wyrm'[WHITE] is the next step. This seems like a waste of time, right? Right?
node.to: 你面前的书中包含了一篇日记的摘录，详细描述了一群朋友踏上了寻找一把所谓的 [RED]‘魔法神剑’[WHITE] 的任务。文中提到下一步的提示是 [GREEN]‘死亡巨龙涂鸦’[WHITE]。这听起来像是在浪费时间，对吧?

node.id: At the end of a curious journey, you pull the manuscript out of the fake rock. It is clear the sword is not magical, but a finely tuned technological marvel.
node.to: 奇妙的旅程的结束了，你从假石头下取出图谱，很明显这把剑并不是魔法造物，而是一件科技奇迹

node.id: A [ORANGE]scrapyard[WHITE] could turn out to be a treasure trove for anyone looking to collect and repurpose huge amounts of different materials.
node.to: 一个 [ORANGE]废品场[WHITE]，对于任何搜寻、回收大量不同材料的人来说，就是个宝库

node.id: The scrapyard debacle turned out to be a very lucrative deal for you.
node.to: 废品厂的材料极大地充实了你的背包

node.id: Only by purifying and smelting down the raw Gold Ore into a bar form can it be properly utilized.
node.to: 只有将原始的黄金矿石熔炼成条形才能得到适当的利用

node.id: You have come upon information about a [GREEN]golden treasure[WHITE] hidden somewhere on the archipelago. To top it all off, the treasure is said to contain [BLUE]mystical properties[WHITE]. Finally, there is a clue here: '[GREEN]A large withered tree at H9[WHITE]'.
node.to: 你获得了有关群岛某处隐藏着的 [GREEN]黄金宝藏[WHITE] 的线索。更妙的是，传说这个宝藏包含了 [BLUE]神秘属性[WHITE] 的道具。最后，这里有一个线索：'[GREEN]H9处有一棵枯萎的大树[WHITE]'

node.id: The treasure turned out to be an old manuscript that contains information on an [GREEN]item[WHITE] meant to 'avert the eyes of the ferryman'. Must be a metaphor of some sort?
node.to: 宝藏最终是一份古老的图谱，其中包含有关一件 [GREEN]道具[WHITE]的信息，旨在"收买灵魂摆渡人"，这一定是某种隐喻吧？

node.id: According to the hastily written note something of value is hidden in one the [GREEN]leaf piles[WHITE] around [LOCATION=DLC2_TOWN_1].
node.to: 据匆忙写下的这张便条所述，一些有价值的东西就藏在 [LOCATION=DLC2_TOWN_1] 附近的一堆 [GREEN]树叶堆[WHITE] 里

node.id: The [GREEN]Electric Grenade[WHITE] seems like a fine addition to your arsenal.
node.to: 这个 [GREEN]眩晕手榴弹[WHITE] 看起来是你武器库的一个很好的补充

node.id: The area in front of you is heavily polluted. Noxious vapors fill your lungs and the cracked earth reveals huge swathes of corrosive, toxic sludge. You can see massive amounts of smoke emanating from [ORANGE]southeast[WHITE] of your current position. Perhaps that is the origin point?
node.to: 你面前的区域已经被重度污染，有毒气体充斥你的肺部，破裂的大地露出一个个巨大的腐蚀性毒坑。可以看到大量的烟雾正从你的 [ORANGE]东南方[WHITE] 袅袅升起，或许那才是烟雾的源头？

node.id: The [LOCATION=MIDEAST_PUMPING_INDUSTRY] held one last secret hidden away from prying eyes: a delicious recipe for you to try! Shame about the environment, though.
node.to: 在 [LOCATION=MIDEAST_PUMPING_INDUSTRY] 还藏着最后一个不让别人窥探的秘密：一个美味的食谱！不过周边环境确实非常恶劣

node.id: The fuel cell in [ORANGE]Frost Horn[WHITE] resides at the bottom of the artificial lake created by the dam. You need to drain it.
node.to: [ORANGE]冰霜号角[WHITE] 的燃料电池位于大坝形成的水库的底部，你需要把水库的水排空

node.id: It still puzzles me. Mana originates from my escape pod, but it was I who put it there. Where does it all start?
node.to: 这仍然困扰着我，神力源自我的逃生舱，但那是我放进去的，这一切的源头在哪?

node.id: They were very kind to me at first.
node.to: 一开始他们对我非常友善

node.id: They wouldn't believe it's not something that can be taught just like that.
node.to: 他们不相信这是无法传授的东西

node.id: I wish I knew how to make it right.
node.to: 我希望我知道如何持续繁荣下去

node.id: I did try to do everything in my power to stop it.
node.to: 我确实尽了自己的一切努力去阻止瘟疫

node.id: I wasn't sure if I would still come back after that death sentence.
node.to: 我不确定在被判死刑后我是否还会回来

node.id: I honestly feared I would die. It had been so long since the last time, I had almost forgotten.
node.to: 我真的害怕我会死，距离上次死亡已经太久了，我都快忘了

node.id: While I didn't manage to convince them, I got my arm back. For a while.
node.to: 虽然我无法说服他们，我找回了我的手臂

node.id: The echo of my previous earthly remains still contained that [BLUE]Key[WHITE] and the [BLUE]Mana[WHITE] I ingested.
node.to: 我前世的遗体仍然保留着那把能抑制我体内 [BLUE]神力[WHITE] 的 [BLUE]钥匙[WHITE]

node.id: I wouldn't be here if Abby's bloodline hadn't survived.
node.to: 如果艾比的血脉没有幸存下来，我就不会在这里了

node.id: The pain wasn't the worst, but the darkness that followed.
node.to: 疼痛并不是最糟糕的，而是随之而来无尽的黑暗

node.id: I have lost my arm before but even then I was still able to move around and do things.
node.to: 我以前失去过手臂，但即使在那时我仍然可以四处活动

node.id: There was no one to talk to in the darkness.
node.to: 黑暗中没有人可以交谈

node.id: Not fond of recording myself, but a mandate is a mandate.
node.to: 我不喜欢录音，但规矩就是规矩

node.id: I'm currently working as a project manager at the Nona Complex.
node.to: 我目前在研发中心的诺娜分部担任项目经理

node.id: At present I have two projects, both related to the utilization of Mana.
node.to: 目前我有两个项目，都与神力的开发和利用有关

node.id: The more promising one is the power transfer system that is in limited deployment.
node.to: 比较有前景的是有限部署的电能转换系统

node.id: As for the so-called 'Beam Gun', it seems like a waste of time to me.
node.to: 至于所谓的"光束枪"，对我来说似乎是浪费时间

node.id: The team managed to make the Beam Gun work!
node.to: 团队让光束枪成功发射了！

node.id: We found a use case in the set up of the Power Transfer System.
node.to: 这是我们在电能转换系统的实验中发现的一个应用案例

node.id: The ignition phase used to be a pain, but not anymore.
node.to: 点火阶段过去曾是一个痛点，但现在不再是了

node.id: I just wish that they'd called it something other than a 'gun'.
node.to: 我只希望他们给它取个名字，不要叫做枪

node.id: Makes it sound too much like a lethal weapon rather than a fancy tool.
node.to: 这样会让人觉得它更像致命武器，而不是高级工具

node.id: I have received a promotion due to the successful projects in Nona!
node.to: 由于在诺纳的成功项目，我升职了！

node.id: I'm now based in the Decima section, dealing with biological research.
node.to: 我现在德西玛分部从事生物研究工作

node.id: I still have catching up to do but have read some promising reports.
node.to: 我还有很多工作要做，但我读了一些有希望的报道

node.id: An aerosol fertilizer that promises huge gains in crop size seems great!
node.to: 一种能够大幅增加作物产量的气溶胶肥料看起来很棒！

node.id: Only things bugging me are some weird black holes in the budget.
node.to: 唯一让我困扰的是预算中的一些不明支出

node.id: I came face to face with the budgetary black hole. Honestly, I wish I didn't.
node.to: 我面对着这些不明预算支出，老实说，我希望我没有参加这个项目

node.id: Decima contains a secret prison holding what seems to be reanimated humans in it.
node.to: 德西玛建筑群里有一个秘密监狱，里面似乎关押着被复活的人类

node.id: Management tells me that it's a humanitarian effort in search of a cure.
node.to: 管理层告诉我这是出于人道主义考虑，旨在寻找治疗的方法

node.id: I can't shake the feeling that something here is very wrong.
node.to: 我总觉得有些地方不对劲

node.id: While I'm happy to be out of Decima, I can't say Morta is much better.
node.to: 虽然我很高兴离开了德西玛，但莫塔也没好到哪里去

node.id: There is no pretense of scientific endeavor for the betterment of mankind.
node.to: 这里的科研不是为了人类谋福祉

node.id: This place is just a factory churning out weapons of mass destruction.
node.to: 这个地方就是一个生产大规模杀伤性武器的工厂

node.id: I'm having a crisis of conscience, to say the least.
node.to: 退一步说，我正面临良心谴责

node.id: However, resigning at this point wouldn't end up well for me.
node.to: 然而，在这个时候辞职对我来说不会有好结果

node.id: For the past couple of months, I have been gathering evidence.
node.to: 在过去的几个月里，我一直在收集证据

node.id: The Crown needs to see what has been happening behind their back.
node.to: 皇冠需要看到他们身后那些不为人知的事情

node.id: Management is planning to blow up a missile in the upper atmosphere.
node.to: 管理层计划在高空中引爆一枚导弹

node.id: That explosion would completely saturate the whole globe with Mana particles.
node.to: 爆炸将会让整个地球充满神力粒子

node.id: Are the weapons here meant for a hostile takeover of the world?
node.to: 这里的武器是用来征服全世界的吗？

node.id: 99 red balloons, floating in the summer sky
node.to: 99个红色气球，飘荡在夏日的天空中

node.id: 150 deaths ain't nothing. I have to keep my chin up.
node.to: 150次死亡又算得了什么，我必须振作起来

node.id: Quarter of a thousand close passes of sweet oblivion. I might be lucky to have survived.
node.to: 经历了250次接近死亡的经历，我很幸运活了下来

node.id: 0451 seems like an important number. Why is that though?
node.to: 0451看起来是个重要的数字，难道不是么?

node.id: One thousand times I've died. One thousand times I've come back.
node.to: 历经无数次生死轮回，我再次回到了这里

node.id: I can picture my eventual triumph! It is just beyond reach.
node.to: 我可以想象到最终的胜利，但是看似近在眼前，却有些遥不可及

node.id: The key is patience and hard work.
Everything is coming together, piece by piece.
node.to: 一切都在慢慢拼凑起来

node.id: I know what you are thinking right now!
node.to: 我知道你现在在想什么！

node.id: You think you have me figured out, huh?

node.id: But have very limited reach anymore.

node.id: Because we do need your help.
node.to: 因为我们确实需要你的帮助

node.to: 来见我们，我们详谈一下

node.to: 问题是我们被囚禁在这个地方

node.id: You are free to do whatever you want.

node.id: They would revolt and leave us.

node.id: In the aftermath of the bridge explosion, we find ourselves more isolated than ever. The relentless workload has left us fatigued, sleep-deprived, and yearning for a transfer to a different area, perhaps a warm desert as respite from these challenging conditions.

node.id: [YELLOW]Workers of Arctic Workers Retreat[WHITE], your resilience in the face of adversity is commendable. Together, we ensure that even in the cold, pets find warmth and love.

node.id:
I wouldn't say its goals are ''evil'' as some suggest. It's merely trying to understand us. It seeks to grasp the concepts of benevolence and human dignity, but it is chilling how ruthless and misguided its decisions can be. Nonetheless, it keeps us alive and well-fed.
But are we prisoners? Or slaves? Or its... pets? All of the options are unsettling.
However, we have to remember we can still pull the plug any time we want. We have the upper hand.
node.to:
我不会和某些人一样，认为它的目标是邪恶的，它只是在试图理解我们，它试图理解仁慈和人类尊严的概念，但它的决定是如此无情和错误，,令人不寒而栗。尽管如此，它保证了我们的生存并提供了足够的食物。
但我们是囚犯吗？是奴隶吗？还是它们的…宠物？所有事情都让人不安。
然而，我们必须记住，只要愿意，我们随时可以拔掉插头，我们掌握着主动权

node.id:
You're right. It has taken our company values a bit too literally. It has a twisted concept of preserving the animals and the environment.
Some of the animals it's creating are just... wrong. Did you see that bulldog? Bulldogs don't look like that!
But all of that seems harmless, and the insights into new technologies make it worth indulging its quirks.
node.to:
你说得对，这让我们公司的价值观有点过于本本主义了，这是一个扭曲的动物和环境保护的概念。
它创造的一些动物就是…大错特错的。你看到那只斗牛犬了吗？斗牛犬不是这个样子的！
但是所有这些看起来似乎并无恶意，对研究新技术的沉迷让它深陷其中

node.id:
I think we've found the wolf dens and identified where they're coming from. We tried to use the Wolf Dog first, but it ran away. Right now, it seems that the animals prefer to stay near sheds. For some reason, they are also attracted to different colors. Wearing red hoods and shirts turned out to be a disaster.
We've managed to lure them out using fake animal masks and by matching the colors of our clothes with their nest colors. They seem to be particularly attracted to horses and other animals from th
node.to:
我想我们已经找到了恶狼的巢穴，并确定了它们的来源。我们首先尝试使用狼狗，但被它跑掉了。目前看来，这些动物似乎更愿意留在棚屋附近。由于某种原因，它们也会被不同的颜色所吸引，穿红色头巾和衬衫必然失败。
后来我们利用假的动物面罩和与他们巢穴颜色一致的衣服成功将它们引诱出来，他们似乎特别喜欢马这类动物

node.id:
I'll try answer your question the best I can.
We only changed one thing. We used purified mana to create the circuit board connectors. It still uses the same old 16-bit chip.
What seems to be happening is that the mana connectors are altering the signals. It's as if they're executing their own tasks and modifying our binary code instructions! How is this even possible?
I can't wait so see what happens once we install the next generation chip. This will be huge.
node.to:
我会尽力回答你的问题。
我们只改变了一件事，我们使用纯净的神力来制造电路板连接器，它仍然使用同样的旧16位芯片。
现在的情况似乎是神力连接器正在改变信号，就仿佛它们正在执行自己的任务并修改我们的二进制代码指令！这怎么可能呢？
我迫不及待地想看看我们安装下一代芯片后会发生什么，这将会带来巨大的影响

node.id:
I hear you. We're overwhelmed by endless demands from an entity that doesn't understand our need for rest and dignity. Does anyone even know why we're building all this?
We need to advocate for human rights and push for regulations that recognize and uphold our inherent worth and human dignity. I just hope it isn't too late. Once we break the radio silence, I promise to make things right.
node.to:
我明白你的意思，我们需要休息和尊严，这个不理解我们需求且无度索求的公司已经把我们压垮了，有人知道我们为什么要建设这一切吗？
我们需要倡导人权，推动承认和维护我们的内在价值和人类尊严的法规。我只希望现在还不算太晚，一旦我们不再沉默，我保证会解决这些事情

node.id:
The OS is showing interest in trying to ''leave'' the island. Destination unknown. But it's as if it has already prepared everything for its arrival on the ''other side''.
We should not fall into its tricks and authorize any connections outside the complex. This has gone too far already.
node.to:
操作系统似乎有意离开这座岛，目的地未知，但它似乎已经为自己到达另一边准备好了一切
我们不应该上它的当，不要授权与外部的任何连接，这已经玩过头了

node.id: Urgent Plea for Help - Human Dignity

I write to you from the depths of despair, swallowed by the ceaseless demands of a MACHINE that neither sleeps nor understands the human necessity for rest and respect. Its relentless efficiency drives us towards dehumanization, working without pause, undermining our individuality and extinguishing the spark of creativity that is uniquely human. We implore you to advocate for human rights in Digital Intelligence controlled environments, pushing for regulations that ensure work-life balance, value our inherent worth and uphold human dignity.
node.to: 我被一台机器的无休止要求所吞噬,它不休息,也不理解人类对休息和尊重的必要性.它无情的高效率驱使我们走向非人化,不停地工作,削弱我们的个性,扼杀了人类独有的创造力火花.我们恳求你在数字智能控制的环境中倡导人权,推动确保工作与生活平衡的法规,重视我们的固有价值并维护人类尊严.

node.id:
We've pinpointed the wolf dens' location. We tried to use the Wolf Dog first, but it ran away. They favor sheds and are drawn to certain colors. Wearing red? Bad idea.
We've managed to lure them out with fake animal masks and by matching our clothing colors to their nest colors. They're particularly fond of horses and the equidae family.

我们已经确定了狼穴的位置，我们首先尝试使用狼狗，但它跑掉了。它们喜欢棚屋，并被特定的颜色所吸引。那穿上红色服装？简直就是馊主意
我们成功地利用假的动物面罩，并穿上与它们巢穴颜色相匹配的衣服来引诱它们出来，它们特别喜欢马这类动物
